column2: Well, it's not as simple as all that. How could anyone turn down all that silver, eh?

column2: Now -- here's my plan. In time of war, you see, a {s0}'s eye wanders far from {reg4?her:his} domain, and {reg4?her:his} subjects suffer. So I've got another idea. I've got a small group of townsfolk together, some men in my employ and some others who've lost relatives to these bandits, and we'll storm the captain's home and bring him in chains before {s4}, hopefully with a few captured bandits to explain how things stack up.
column3: 现在——这是我的计划。我可以把这件事报告给这座城的领主{s4}，但那就意味着一场调查，我的话对质队长的话，而证人可以收买，证据可以销毁，或者如果敌人再次越境，整件事就会被抛诸脑后，而我费这番周折唯一能得到的就是肋下挨一刀。你知道，在战时，{s0}的目光远离{reg4?她:他}的领地，{reg4?她:他}的臣民就要遭殃。所以我有另一个主意。我召集了一小群市民，有些是我雇的人，有些是被这些强盗害死了亲人的人，我们会冲进队长的家，把他绑到{s4}面前，最好再抓几个强盗来说明事情的来龙去脉。

column2: You may do as you wish, {sir/my lady}, but I am disappointed. You would do well to reconsider. I am a rich {reg65?woman:man}, and would show you my gratitude in coin.

column2: Ah... {playername}. Things didn't go quite so well as I had hoped. {s5} couldn't quite find it in {reg4?her:him} to overlook my little breach of the peace. Oh, {reg4?she:he}'s grateful enough that I got rid of {reg4?her:his} crooked captain -- a guard who'll let in bandits will let in an enemy army, if the price is right -- but {reg4?she:he} can't exactly have me running around here as a lasting reminder of {reg4?her:his} failure to take care of things {reg4?herself:himself}.
column3: 啊……{playername}。事情不如我希望的那样顺利。{s5}实在没法对我那点小小的扰乱治安视而不见。哦，{reg4?她:他}倒是很感激我除掉了{reg4?她:他}那个腐败的队长——一个会放强盗进城的守卫，只要价钱合适，也会放敌军进城——可是{reg4?她:他}总不能让我在这里四处走动，时时提醒别人{reg4?她自己:他自己}没能管好这些事。

column2: Fair? This is Calradia, {my boy/my girl}! Kings do what they will, and the rest of us do as they must. {reg4?She:He} didn't string me up, and instead gave me time to sell my properties -- even put in a word with the other merchants that they best pay me a fair price, too. That's gracious enough, as kings go -- but {reg4?she:he}'s a weak king, as they all are here, and weak kings must always look to their authority first, and justice second. I suppose I'd do the same, in {reg4?her:his} shoes.
column3: 公平？这里是卡拉迪亚，{孩子/姑娘}！国王们为所欲为，我们其他人只能逆来顺受。{reg4?她:他}没有把我吊起来，反而给了我时间变卖产业——甚至还跟别的商人打了招呼，让他们最好给我个公道价钱。就国王而言，这已经够宽厚的了——但{reg4?她:他}是个软弱的国王，这里的国王都是这样，而软弱的国王总是先顾自己的威信，其次才是公正。我想，换作我处在{reg4?她:他}的位置，也会这么做。

column2: Anyway, I wouldn't go rubbing your part in this affair in {s5}'s face -- but {reg4?she:he}'s taken note of you, and decided that you're not worth hanging, and that's something to which I'll raise a glass any day of the week. {reg4?She:He} might even have work for you, further down the road. Or, you can sell your {s0} to one of {reg4?her:his} competitors. Anyway, I hope you've learned a bit about what it will take to stay alive in this troubled land, and I suspect that the money you've earned won't go to waste. Good luck.
column3: 总之，我不会在{s5}面前炫耀你在这件事里的功劳——但{reg4?她:他}已经注意到你了，并认定你不值得绞死，就凭这一点，我随时都愿意为你举杯。往后{reg4?她:他}说不定还会有差事给你。或者，你也可以把你的{s0}卖给{reg4?她:他}的某个对手。总之，我希望你学到了一些在这片动荡之地活下去的门道，我想你挣到的钱也不会白白浪费。祝你好运。

column3: 你已经从这座{reg0?城镇:城堡}雇用了最多{reg0?4:2}名征兵官。

column2: If you want, I will send someone to visit nearby villages and enlist their population to our forces. After he has recruited the amount you ordered he returns to this {reg0?town:castle} and put the recruits in the garrison. There's a limit for concurrent recruiters, which is 2 for castles and 4 for towns. What kind of recruits do you want?
column3: 如果你愿意，我会派人去附近的村庄征召村民加入我们的军队。他招够你下令的人数后，就会回到这座{reg0?城镇:城堡}，把新兵编入驻军。同时派出的征兵官有上限，城堡为2名，城镇为4名。你想要什么样的新兵？

column2: You have to pay {reg10} denars for each recruit and {reg11} denars for the recruiter. I will take the money from the treasury. How many recruits are you willing to pay for?
column3: 每名新兵你要支付{reg10}第纳尔，征兵官另收{reg11}第纳尔。我会从国库里支取这笔钱。你愿意为多少名新兵付钱？

column2: Do you really want to recruit {reg11} {s11}? This will cost us {reg12} denars in total.
column3: 你真的要招募{reg11}名{s11}吗？这总共要花{reg12}第纳尔。

column2: I want to focus on the gender balance of our troops.
column3: 我想关注一下我们部队的男女比例。

column2: Very well. Currently, for every 100 men we field, we will also have {reg10} women fighting alongside them. How would you like to redistribute our recruiting efforts?
column3: 很好。目前，我们每派出100名男兵，就会有{reg10}名女兵与他们并肩作战。你想如何调整我们的征兵比例？

column2: Let's talk about patrols and troop movement.
column3: 我们来谈谈巡逻和部队调动吧。

column2: I want to move troops to another location.
column3: 我想把部队调往另一个地点。

column2: Where do you want to move the troops?
You didn't choose any soldiers. Seems like you changed your mind.
column3: 你没有选择任何士兵。看来你改主意了。

column2: Do you really want to send the troops to {s9}? This will cost us {reg5} denars.
column3: 你真的要把部队派往{s9}吗？这要花{reg5}第纳尔。

column2: No. Let me check if we can afford that.
column3: 不。让我看看我们是否负担得起。

column2: I want to enlist a patrol.

You can take troops from your garrison or enlist fresh troops. In the latter case you can enlist a small patrol for 1000 denars, a medium patrol for 2000 denars or a big patrol for 3000 denars. You can also enlist a small elite patrol for 2000 denars. We have to pay weekly wages for the soldiers so make sure you have enough money in the treasury.
column3: 你可以从驻军中抽调部队，也可以征召新兵。如果征召新兵，小型巡逻队要1000第纳尔，中型巡逻队要2000第纳尔，大型巡逻队要3000第纳尔。你也可以花2000第纳尔组建一支小型精英巡逻队。我们每周都要支付士兵的薪水，所以要确保国库里有足够的钱。

column2: Currently there are no fresh troops available. We have to wait {reg0} days. {reg1?But you can take troops from your garrison:We do not have any troops ready in the garrison either}.
column3: 目前没有可用的新兵。我们得等{reg0}天。{reg1?不过你可以从驻军中抽调部队:驻军里也没有可调用的部队}。

column2: Take troops out of the garrison.
My {lord/lady}, lets muster the patrol troops.
column3: 我的{大人/夫人}，让我们召集巡逻部队吧。

column2: Where do you want to send the patrol?
column3: 你想把巡逻队派往哪里？

column2: Do you really want to send the patrol to {s9}?
column3: 你真的要把巡逻队派往{s9}吗？

column2: Do you really want to send a {s8} patrol to {s9}?
column3: 你真的要派一支{s8}巡逻队去{s9}吗？

column2: I want to change the target of a patrol.
column3: 我想改变一支巡逻队的目标。

column2: Which patrol should change the target?
column3: 哪支巡逻队要改变目标？

column2: Where do you want to send it?
As you wish, I will send a messenger carrying the orders to patrol {s6} to the {s5}.
column3: 遵命，我会派一名信使把在{s6}巡逻的命令送给{s5}。

column2: I want a patrol to return to a center.
column3: 我想让一支巡逻队返回某个据点。

column2: Which patrol should move to a center?
column3: 哪支巡逻队要前往据点？

column2: As you wish, I will send a messenger carrying the orders to move to {s6} to the {s5}.
column3: 遵命，我会派一名信使把前往{s6}的命令送给{s5}。

column2: I want to disband a patrol.
Which patrol do you want to disband?
As you wish, I will send a messenger who will tell {s5} to disband.
column3: 遵命，我会派一名信使去通知{s5}解散。

column2: I have some prisoners -- can you sell them for me?
column3: 我有些俘虏——你能帮我卖掉吗？

column2: We have prisoners in the dungeon -- let's have a look over them.
column3: 我们地牢里有俘虏——我们去看看吧。

column2: Of course, {s0}. There are {reg0} prisoners left{reg1? and {reg1} nobles incarcerated:}.
column3: 当然，{s0}。还剩{reg0}名俘虏{reg1?，另有{reg1}名贵族被关押:}。

column2: Hopefully they'll get some honest labor done instead of languishing in the dungeon.
column3: 但愿他们能去干点正经活，而不是在地牢里虚度光阴。

column2: If that's what you wish, {s0}. I still have some gear you entrusted me with, so I would be remiss in my duty if you sent me packing without seeing to the care of those items first.
column3: 如果这是您的意愿，{s0}。我这里还有一些您托付给我的装备，如果您还没处理好这些东西就把我打发走，那我就是失职了。

column2: Are you sure you no longer require my services?
column3: 您确定不再需要我的服务了吗？

column2: Well, let me take a look...
On second thought, I still need you at your post.
column3: 我又想了想，我还需要你留在你的岗位上。

column2: I'll miss my place at your side, {playername}. May your blades stay sharp and your arrows fly true.
column3: 我会怀念在你身边的日子，{playername}。愿你的刀锋永远锐利，箭矢永远命中。

column2: Thank you, I will come back to you later.
Please give me a report about financial affairs.
column3: 请给我一份关于财务状况的报告。
我们去查看一下国库吧。

column2: There are currently {s4} in the treasury and we have {s6} of debt. What do you want to do?
column3: 国库里目前有{s4}，我们还欠债{s6}。您想做什么？

column2: I would like to pay into the treasury.
We currently have {s1} in the treasury. How much money do you like to pay into the treasury, Sire?
column3: 国库里目前有{s1}。陛下，您想往国库里存多少钱？

column2: I would like to withdraw money from the treasury.
We currently have {s4} denars in the treasury. How much money do you like to withdraw from the treasury, Sire?
column3: 国库里目前有{s4}第纳尔。陛下，您想从国库里取多少钱？

column2: Thank you, let's talk about something else.
Please give me a status report about the financial situation of a fief.
column3: 请给我一份关于某块封地财务状况的报告。

column2: Which fief would you like a report on?
column3: 您想要哪块封地的报告？

column2: I wish to change the tax rate for a fief.
column3: 我想更改某块封地的税率。

column2: How high do you want to set the tax rate for {s6}? The people are likely to grumble while they toil under a high tax regime, while they might become more accepting towards us or even prosper under a more forgiving hand.
column3: 您想把{s6}的税率定得多高？在高税之下辛苦劳作，人民很可能会怨声载道；而在更宽厚的统治下，他们也许会更认可我们，甚至变得富裕起来。

column2: Do you really want to set the tax rate for {s6} to {s11}?
column3: 您真的要把{s6}的税率定为{s11}吗？

column2: I would like to manage fief improvements.
column3: 我想管理封地的建设项目。

column2: We are currently have {reg0} improvements in {reg1} of your {reg2} fiefs. Do you want to build another one?
column3: 目前在您的{reg2}块封地中，有{reg1}块封地里共有{reg0}项建筑。您想再建一项吗？

column2: Yes, I want to build an improvement.
column3: 是的，我想建造一项建筑。

column2: Where do you want to build an improvement?
{s19}  You are currently building {s7}. The building will be completed after {reg8} day{reg9?s:}. We have to wait until it's finished.
column3: {s19}  您目前正在建造{s7}。还需要{reg8}天{reg9?:}才能完工。我们得等它建完。

column2: {s19}  What do you want to build?
Are you sure that you want to build a {s4} for {reg5} in {s2}? It will take {reg6} days. We currently have {reg7} denars in the treasury.
column3: 您确定要花{reg5}在{s2}建造一座{s4}吗？这需要{reg6}天。国库里目前有{reg7}第纳尔。

column2: No, I don't have the money.
I would like to manage the {reg0?household and secondary storage:household}.
column3: 我想管理{reg0?府中和其他仓库的物品:府中的物品}。

column2: What do you want to do?
I would like to manage the goods in secondary storage.
column3: 我想管理其他仓库里的物品。

column2: Let my companions take the items out of the item pool.
column3: 让我的同伴从物品池中拿取物品。

column2: Are you sure you wish to do this?
I would like to manage the household.
You left certain items in my keeping. If you are sure about this, would you kindly go through them to see what you wish to retain first?
column3: 您把某些物品交给了我保管。如果您确定要这样做，能否先把它们清点一遍，看看您想留下哪些？

column2: I've got better things to do - you can keep your job.
column3: 我还有更重要的事要做——你继续干你的差事吧。

column2: Are you sure that you want to handle all financial affairs by yourself?
column3: 您确定要亲自处理所有的财务事务吗？

column2: As you wish. Let's go through the documents and hand over your estate.
column3: 遵命。我们来过一遍文书，把您的产业交接给您。

column2: Oh nothing, I just wanted to check the documents.
column3: 哦，没什么，我只是想看看文书。

column2: I bid you goodbye, {playername}. May you have the best of luck with the realm's finances, and don't forget to spend less on butter for the feasts.
column3: 那我就告辞了，{playername}。愿您在王国财政上一切顺利，别忘了宴会上的黄油要少花点钱。

column2: I want to hire a new staff member.
column3: 我想雇用一名新的属官。

column2: What sort of staff member would you like to hire?
I want to appoint a constable.
I assume you will want to rehire your former constable Miles de Gloucester?  His rate is still {reg10} denars each week, and the appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 我想您会愿意重新雇用您以前的治安官格洛斯特的迈尔斯吧？他的薪水仍是每周{reg10}第纳尔，任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: I have heard good things about a local nobleman by the name of Miles de Gloucester, and I believe he would be well-suited for the job. He demands {reg10} denars each week, though. The appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 我听说当地有位名叫格洛斯特的迈尔斯的贵族口碑很好，我相信他很适合这份差事。不过他要求每周{reg10}第纳尔。任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: That's a wise idea. May I suggest a very capable nobleman and friend of my family? His name is Miles de Gloucester. He demands {reg10} denars each week, though. The appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 这是个明智的想法。我可以推荐一位非常能干的贵族吗？他是我们家族的朋友，名叫格洛斯特的迈尔斯。不过他要求每周{reg10}第纳尔。任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: Very well, I will send him a letter - he should arrive at our court soon.
column3: 很好，我会给他写封信——他应该很快就会来到我们的宫廷。

column2: I will send him a letter, he should arrive at the court soon.
column3: 我会给他写封信，他应该很快就会来到宫廷。

column2: I want to appoint a chamberlain to handle financial affairs.
column3: 我想任命一位内务大臣来处理财务事务。

column2: I assume you will want to rehire your former chamberlain Aubrey de Vere?  His rate is still {reg10} denars each week, and the appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 我想您会愿意重新雇用您以前的内务大臣奥布里·德·维尔吧？他的薪水仍是每周{reg10}第纳尔，任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: I have heard good things about a local nobleman by the name of Aubrey de Vere, and I believe he would be well-suited for the job. He demands {reg10} denars each week, though. The appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 我听说当地有位名叫奥布里·德·维尔的贵族口碑很好，我相信他很适合这份差事。不过他要求每周{reg10}第纳尔。任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: That's a wise idea. May I suggest a very capable nobleman and friend of my family? His name is Aubrey de Vere. He demands {reg10} denars each week, though. The appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 这是个明智的想法。我可以推荐一位非常能干的贵族吗？他是我们家族的朋友，名叫奥布里·德·维尔。不过他要求每周{reg10}第纳尔。任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: I want to appoint a chancellor.
I assume you will want to rehire your former chancellor Herfast? His rate is still {reg11} denars each week, and the appointment will cost us {reg10} denars.
column3: 我想您会愿意重新雇用您以前的宰相赫法斯特吧？他的薪水仍是每周{reg11}第纳尔，任命要花{reg10}第纳尔。

column2: I have heard good things about a local nobleman by the name of Herfast, and I believe he would be well-suited for the job. He demands {reg10} denars each week, though. The appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 我听说当地有位名叫赫法斯特的贵族口碑很好，我相信他很适合这份差事。不过他要求每周{reg10}第纳尔。任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: That's a wise idea. May I suggest a very capable nobleman and friend of my family? His name is Herfast. He demands {reg10} denars each week, though. The appointment will cost us {reg11} denars.
column3: 这是个明智的想法。我可以推荐一位非常能干的贵族吗？他是我们家族的朋友，名叫赫法斯特。不过他要求每周{reg10}第纳尔。任命要花{reg11}第纳尔。

column2: Can you please buy some bread?
How much bread do you want?
Yes of course, I will go to the merchant in {s6} and buy some bread. This will cost us {reg0} denars.
column3: 当然，我会去{s6}的商人那里买些面包。这要花{reg0}第纳尔。

column2: Currently no merchant has enough bread. We have to wait.
column3: 目前没有哪个商人有足够的面包。我们得等一等。

column2: Ok, we can afford that, please go. Thank you.
column3: 好的，我们负担得起，请去吧。谢谢。

column2: {s66}, I want to give up a fief you enfeoffed to me.
column3: {s66}，我想放弃您册封给我的一块封地。

column2: Oh, so you can't manage it? Well, which fief do you have in mind?
column3: 哦，你管不了了？好吧，你说的是哪块封地？

column2: So you think you can't fulfill your promise and manage {s11}?
column3: 这么说你觉得自己无法履行诺言，管理好{s11}了？

column2: Yes I want to give up on {s11}.
No, I will keep the promise.
{s66}, you should declare a truce for this war.
column3: {s66}，您应该在这场战争中宣布停战。

column2: Who do you think you are, to dictate such terms of strategy? I'll not suffer another word from you!
column3: 你以为你是谁，竟敢对我的战略指手画脚？我一个字也不想再听你说！

column2: Do you take me for a fool, {playername}? My spies bring me tales of your transgressions in this campaign, do not think your sweet words will make up for your gross misconduct. {reg10?I know of your fraternization with our foe, {s10}. :}Your cowardice is noted and your petition is denied.
column3: 你当我是傻瓜吗，{playername}？我的密探向我禀报了你在这场战役中的种种劣迹，别以为几句甜言蜜语就能弥补你的严重失职。{reg10?我知道你和我们的敌人{s10}有来往。:}你的懦弱我已记下，你的请求被驳回了。

column2: You believe we should stop fighting the {s1}?
column3: 你认为我们应该停止与{s1}作战？

column2: I will humour your request. Which of our opponents do you believe to be worthy of a truce?
column3: 我就姑且听听你的请求。你认为我们的哪个对手值得停战？

column2: They have far more holdings, we are not making enough progress.
column3: 他们的领地比我们多得多，我们没有取得足够的进展。

column2: We have already reclaimed the objective of the war.
column3: 我们已经夺回了这场战争的目标。

column2: The bloodshed has gone on long enough. The people are suffering.
column3: 流血已经够久了。人民在受苦。

column2: We are fighting on too many fronts simultaneously.
column3: 我们同时在太多条战线上作战。

column2: I mentioned all reasons for peace to be brokered between our realm and {s11}. I truly believe this is a necessary step.
column3: 我已经说明了我们王国与{s11}议和的所有理由。我真心认为这是必要的一步。

column2: I will be back with more evidence.
column3: 我会带着更多证据回来。

column2: Interesting, anything else you'd like to contribute?
column3: 有意思，你还有什么要补充的吗？

column2: Your words have convinced me. I will send out the heralds - we will no longer fight against the {s11}.
column3: 你的话说服了我。我会派出传令官——我们不再与{s11}作战。

column2: No, I am far from convinced. We must keep fighting {s11}.
column3: 不，我远没有被说服。我们必须继续与{s11}作战。

column2: {s66}, you should declare war on a kingdom.
How can you dare? Who do you think you are? Get out of my sight!
column3: 你怎么敢？你以为你是谁？给我滚出去！

column2: Why should I declare war against the {s11}?
They are weaker and we can easily beat them.
column3: 他们比我们弱，我们能轻易打败他们。

column2: We can't tolerate their provocations any longer.
column3: 我们不能再容忍他们的挑衅了。

column2: They are already in war and currently distracted.
column3: 他们已经身陷战争，眼下无暇他顾。

column2: It's the right time to attack.
column3: 现在正是进攻的好时机。

column2: We should get back our lost land.
column3: 我们应该夺回失去的土地。

column2: I mentioned all reasons for war. Please think about it!
column3: 我已经说明了开战的所有理由。请您考虑一下！

column2: I need to think about that in peace and quiet.
column3: 我需要静下心来好好想想。

column2: Gird your {s0} we are going to war against {s11}.
column3: 佩好你的{s0}，我们要向{s11}开战了。

column2: No, I am not convinced. We won't attack {s11}.
column3: 不，我没有被说服。我们不会进攻{s11}。

column2: I have done my share with your family, I want to be discharged of my pledge.
column3: 我已经为您的家族尽了我的本分，我希望解除我的誓约。

column2: I do not want to be related to your house anymore.
column3: 我不想再和您的家族有任何关系了。

column2: You dare stand and face me to declaim your disavowal ! Well, your betrayal cannot make up for frankness. You disappoint the confidence my clan have put in you, {playername}. Each will condemn you in all conscience... but since I avouched your phoney allegiance, I will personally report to Calradia noblemen about your frivolous plot.
column3: 你竟敢站在我面前公然宣布背弃！好吧，你的坦率也弥补不了你的背叛。你辜负了我的家族对你的信任，{playername}。人人都会凭良心谴责你……既然当初是我为你虚伪的效忠作保，我会亲自把你轻率的阴谋告诉卡拉迪亚的贵族们。

column2: I have great respect for your lineage, I wish to be affiliated to your family.
column3: 我非常敬重您的家世，希望能依附于您的家族。

column2: I {reg0?like you well enough:have nothing against you}, but I just don't think it would work out, so I will not sponsor you.
column3: 我{reg0?对你颇有好感:对你没什么意见}，但我觉得这行不通，所以我不会为你担保。

column2: Not a chance. Since I dislike you, I will not sponsor you.
column3: 门儿都没有。我不喜欢你，所以我不会为你担保。

column2: Please {reg65?my lady:sire}, let me serve your family.
column3: 求求您，{reg65?夫人:大人}，让我为您的家族效力吧。

column2: On second thought, I have to reconsider this decision.
column3: 我又想了想，我得重新考虑这个决定。

column2: Maybe some of my family doesn't think too highly of you. Or maybe I just need some time to get used to the idea. Either way, let's talk further about it next week.
column3: 也许我家族里有些人不太看得起你。也可能我只是需要一些时间来适应这个想法。不管怎样，我们下周再详谈吧。

column2: I am honored and grateful to be affiliated with your family.
column3: 能依附于您的家族，我深感荣幸和感激。

After that, if you persist in attempting to see {reg0?her:him}, everyone shall know that you are a {man/woman} of scant honor.

column2: {Bastard/Bitch}. We will fight you to the last man!

column3: 总有一天我会为此把你的头插在长矛上，你这个{杂种/贱人}！总有一天！

column2: If you pay me {reg0} denars I will let you go, recreant.

column2: Are you sure you will be up to the task, {playername}? Reclaiming my throne will be no simple matter.The {s0} of our realm have all sworn oaths of homage to {s11}.Such oaths to a usurper are of course invalid, and we can expect some of the {s0} to side with us, but it will be a very tough and challenging struggle ahead.
column3: 你确定你能胜任这个任务吗，{playername}？夺回我的王位并不是件简单的事情。我们王国的{s0}都已发誓向{s11}效忠。这种向篡位者发的誓言当然是无效的，我们可以期待其中一些{s0}来投靠我们，但前方将是一场极其艰难的斗争。

column2: I have no doubt that your support for my cause is heartfelt, {playername}, and I am grateful to you for it. But I don't think we have much of a chance of success. If you can gain renown in the battlefield and make a name for yourself as a great commander, then our friends would not hesitate to join our cause, and our enemies would be wary to take up arms against us. When that time comes, I will come with you gladly. But until that time, it will be wiser not to openly challenge the usurper, {s11}.
column3: 我 对 你 协 助 我 事 业 的 一 片 忠 心 毫 无 疑 虑 ， {playername}， 并 且 我 对 此 非 常 感 激 。 但 是 我 不 认 为 我 们 有 多 少 成 功 的 可 能 。 如 果 你 可 以 在 战 场 上 获 得 声 望 并 且 让 你 以 一 个 伟 大 的 指 挥 官 而 闻 名 ， 这 样 我 们 的 朋 友 在 加 入 我 们 的 事 业 的 时 候 将 不 会 犹 豫 ， 并 且 我 们 的 敌 人 将 会 在 和 我 们 动 武 的 时 候 有 所 顾 虑 。 当 时 机 成 熟 ， 我 将 很 乐 意 加 入 你 。 但 是 直 到 那 之 前 ， 聪 明 的 做 法 就 是 别 公 开 挑 战 那 个 篡 位 者 ， {s11}。

column2: You are a capable warrior, {playername}, and I am sure with your renown as a commander, and my righteous cause, the nobles and the good people of {s12} will flock to our support. column2: Hmph. As you wish, {playername}.Just remember that a {man/woman} needs friends in this world, and you'll never make any if you never stand with anyone.

column2: It is good to see you, old friend

{playername}, I've been expecting you. Word has reached my ears of your exploits.Why, I keep hearing such tales of prowess and bravery that my mind was quickly made up.I knew that I had found someone worthy of becoming my vassal.
column3: {playername}， 我 一 直 很 期 待 你 。 我 听 到 了 一 些 关 于 你 事 迹 的 传 闻 。 嗯 ， 我 一 直 听 到 的 那 些 关 于 威 猛 和 英 勇 的 传 闻 让 我 很 快 下 了 决 心 。 我 知 道 我 已 经 找 到 了 值 得 成 为 我 的 封 臣 的 人 。

column2: My {lord/lady}, I have been giving much thought to our recent conversation. It is time for me to ask. Would you do me the honor of becoming my {husband/wife}?
column3: 我的{大人/女士}，我一直在反复思考我们最近的谈话。现在是我开口的时候了。你愿意给我这份荣幸，成为我的{丈夫/妻子}吗？

column2: Of course, my {lord/lady}. Take all the time you need.
column3: 当然，我的{大人/女士}，你需要多长时间都行。

column2: Do you mean to reject my suit outright, my {lord/lady}?
column3: 你真的打算断然拒绝我的求婚吗，我的{大人/女士}？

column2: Well, in that case, let me tell you something -- with those harsh words, you have removed the scales from my eyes. I would agree that it would not be appropriate for me to marry one such as you. Good day, my {lord/lady}.
column3: 好吧，既然如此，让我告诉你一些事情——这些伤人的话让我看清了你。我也认为与像你这样的人结婚是不合适的。日安，我的{大人/女士}。

column2: Such is your right, my {lord/lady}. If you ever wished to reconsider, I would be overwhelmed with joy.
column3: 这是你的权利，我的{大人/女士}。如果你能重新考虑一下，我会欣喜若狂的。

column2: My {lord/lady}, it brings my heart great joy to see you again...
column3: 我的{大人/女士}，再次见到你让我的心充满喜悦……

column2: My {lord/lady}, I am always your humble servant
column3: 我的{大人/女士}，我永远是你卑微的仆人

column2: My name is {playername}. At your service {reg65?madame:sir}.
column3: 我的名字是{playername}。乐意为您效劳，{reg65?夫人:先生}。

column2: Your surgeon managed to convince my friend and made the operation. The matter is in God's hands now, and all we can do is pray for his recovery. Anyway, I thank you for lending your surgeon to me {sir/madam}. You have a noble spirit. I will not forget it.
column3: 你 的 医 生 设 法 说 服 了 我 的 朋 友 做 这 个 手 术 。 现 在 成 功 与 否 只 有 天 知 道 了 ， 我 们 能 做 的 只 有 祈 祷 他 能 够 康 复 。 无 论 如 何 ， 感 谢 你 提 供 了 你 的 医 生 给 我 {先 生 /夫 人 }。 你 的 高 尚 品 格 。 我 永 远 不 会 忘 记 。

column2: Hah! Our little plot against {s3} worked perfectly, {playername}.The fool has lost one of {reg0?her:his} most valuable retainers, and we are one step closer to bringing {reg0?her:him} to {reg0?her:his} knees.Here, this purse contains {reg5} denars, and I wish you to have it. You deserve every copper.And, need I remind you, there could be much more to come if you've a mind to earn it...
column3: 哈！我们对付{s3}的小阴谋进行得很顺利，{playername}。那个蠢货失去了{reg0?她:他}最得力的一个部下，我们离让{reg0?她:他}屈服又近了一步。给，这个钱袋里有{reg5}第纳尔，我希望你收下。这是你应得的每一个铜板。而且，我要提醒你，如果你有心去挣，以后还会有更多……

column2: You werent't able to complete a simple task. I had set up everything.The only thing you needed to do was sacrifice a messenger, and we would be celebrating now.But no, you were too damned honorable, weren't you?

column2: Brilliant work, {playername}! Whatever you did, the nobles of the {s13} are clamoring for war!Soon, the time will come for us to reap the benefits of our hard work, from fields ripe for plunder.This war is going to make us rich, mark my words!
column3: 做 的 太 好 了 ， {playername}！ 不 管 你 做 了 什 么 ， {s13}正 在 嚷 嚷 着 要 开 战 ！ 很 快 ， 就 要 到 了 从 战 场 上 摘 取 战 利 品 来 为 我 们 的 辛 苦 工 作 收 获 好 处 的 时 候 了 。 这 一 仗 将 让 我 们 成 为 有 钱 人 ， 记 住 我 的 话 ！

column2: I must admit I'm impressed, {playername}. I had lost hope of ever getting this money back.Please accept my sincere thanks.
column3: 我得承认你让我刮目相看，{playername}。我本来已经不指望能收回这笔钱了。请接受我诚挚的谢意。

column2: You! Do you have sawdust between your ears? Did you think that when I said to kill the merchant,I meant you to have a nice chat with him and then let him go?! What possessed you?
column3: 你 ！ 你 的 耳 朵 进 了 锯 木 屑 了 吗 ？ 你 认 为 我 说 要 你 去 杀 那 个 商 人 的 意 思 是 叫 你 和 他 闲 聊 并 送 他 走 ？ ！ 你 到 底 被 什 么 东 西 迷 惑 了 ？

Don't say a word, {playername}, you're lucky to get even that.I have little use for {men/women} who cannot follow orders.
column3: 胡 扯 ！ 你 本 应 该 是 去 干 掉 他 的 ， 而 不 是 对 他 进 行 说 教 并 放 他 走 。 他 最 好 是 像 你 说 的 那 样 ， 否 则 你 们 两 人 都 会 后 悔 的 。 给 你 ， 这 是 我 向 你 承 诺 的 钱 的 一 半 。 不 要 废 话 ， {playername}， 能 得 到 这 点 钱 你 已 经 很 幸 运 了 。 不 听 我 命 令 的 {人 /人 }对 我 来 说 一 点 用 都 没 有 。

column2: Beautiful work, {playername}! You captured both the spy and {reg0?her:his} handler, just as I'd hoped,and the pair are now safely ensconced in my dungeon, waiting to be questioned.My torturer shall be busy tonight! column2: I asked you for two prisoners, {playername}, not one. Two. Still, I suppose you did capture the spy's handler,the more important one of the pair. column2: Splendid work, {playername}. All the serfs are back, properly cowed, and they're busy preparing for the harvest.You certainly earned your reward. Here, take it, with my compliments.
column3: 干 得 不 错 ， {playername}。 所 有 的 农 奴 都 回 来 了 ， 并 准 备 忙 着 收 割 。 你 干 的 非 常 好 ， {playername}。 拿 去 ， 这 是 你 的 报 酬 ， 祝 贺 你 。

column3: 对不起，{reg65?夫人:先生}，我另有打算。

column2: {playername}, I need a volunteer to scout the area. We're sorely lacking on information,and I simply must have a better picture of the situation before we can proceed.I want you to go to {s13}, {s14} and {s15} and report back whatever you find.

column2: By the way, I am sure that my {s11}, {s14}, would be delighted were you to pay {reg0?her:him} a visit. {reg0?She:He} awaits you in {reg0?her:his} chambers.
column3: 顺便说一下，我相信如果你去拜访我的{s11}{s14}，{reg0?她:他}会很高兴的。{reg0?她:他}正在{reg0?她:他}的房间里等你。

column2: I heard that you have captured our enemy {s3} and {reg0?she:he} is with you at the moment.I can pay you {reg6} denars for {reg0?her:him} if you want to get rid of {reg0?her:him}.You can wait for {reg0?her:his} family to pay {reg0?her:his} ransom of course, but there is no telling how long that will take, eh?

column3: 太好了！这是你的{reg6}第纳尔。我马上派人把他押到我们的监狱去。

column2: My {reg65?lady:lord} -- there is something I wish to tell you in confidence, about one of your vassals.
column3: 我的{reg65?夫人:大人}——有件关于您手下某位封臣的事，我想私下告诉您。

column2: What is it? I value your opinion, although I hope that you are not trying to sow dissension among my vassals?
column3: 是 什 么 ？ 我 很 重 视 你 的 意 见 ， 尽 管 我 希 望 你 不 是 打 算 在 我 的 封 臣 之 中 制 造 不 合 。

column2: But enough talking -- yield or fight!
column3: 我 说 得 够 多 了 ， 投 降 或 者 开 战 ！

我没有冒犯您的意思，{先生/夫人}。

column3: 是的，我听说了{s1}的困境。不过，{reg4?她:他}只是我的一个远房{s11}，我觉得没有义务出钱。

column2: I prefer to distance myself from {s1}'s follies in the {s2} -- surely you can see I hold no responsibility.
column3: 我宁愿跟{s1}在{s2}干的蠢事撇清关系——你也看得出来，这跟我没有任何关系。

column2: How dare you petition me on that {s43}'s behalf, {playername}? You try my patience...
column3: 你怎么敢替那个{s43}来求我，{playername}？你在考验我的耐心……

column2: I have no love for {s1}, let {reg4?her:him} rot.
column3: 我对{s1}毫无好感，让{reg4?她:他}烂在那里吧。

column2: I believe that, between {s12} and yourself, enough funds have been secured for ransoming {s11}. I can give you nothing more except my blessings.
column3: 我相信，加上{s12}和你筹到的钱，已经足够赎回{s11}了。除了我的祝福，我没有别的可以给你了。

column2: Of course, {playername}. {s1} is my {s4} and I will lend whatever help I can...
column3: 当然，{playername}。{s1}是我的{s4}，我会尽我所能帮忙……

column2: However, my coffers are severely depleted at the moment -- {s1} will have to wait a while longer.
column3: 不过，我的钱库眼下非常空虚——{s1}只能再等一阵子了。

column2: Then take it with my blessings, {playername}. Give {s1} my regards.
column3: 那就带着我的祝福拿去吧，{playername}。代我向{s1}问好。

column2: What are you playing at, {playername}? We both want {s1} freed, do we not?
column3: 你在搞什么名堂，{playername}？我们都希望{s1}获释，不是吗？

column2: Actually, forget about this for now.
column3: 其实，这件事暂且先放一放吧。

column2: Then you will have to ask someone else.
I am afraid you will have to ask someone else.
column3: 恐怕你只能去问别人了。

column2: Have no fear, I have no intention of changing my mind.  We will be married as soon as there is an opportunity worthy of the august event.
column3: 别担心，我无意改变主意。一旦有了与这桩盛事相称的机会，我们就结婚。

column2: I do not forget that it was your strong right arm that placed me on this throne. Do you aim to take Baybak's place as my {husband/wife}, to rule the {s0} with me as Commander of the Armies even as I am Mother of the Realm?
column3: 我没有忘记，是你那强有力的臂膀把我扶上了这个王位。你是想取代拜巴克，成为我的{丈夫/妻子}，与我一同统治{s0}——你统帅三军，而我是一国之母吗？

column2: Are you proposing to rule the {s0} alongside me as my {husband/wife}?
column3: 你是在提议作为我的{丈夫/妻子}，与我一同统治{s0}吗？

column2: No, I think you have misunderstood me.  Forget I brought it up.
column3: 不，我想你误会我了。就当我没提过吧。

column2: Oh, HELL no!  No, you totally have the wrong idea... forget I said anything.
column3: 噢，绝对不是！不，你完全想错了……就当我什么都没说。

column2: Unfortunately this is impossible, since I am already married to {s0}.
column3: 很遗憾，这是不可能的，因为我已经和{s0}结婚了。

column2: Unfortunately this is impossible, since you are already married to {s0}.
column3: 很遗憾，这是不可能的，因为你已经和{s0}结婚了。

column2: Unfortunately this is impossible, since I am already engaged to {s0}.
column3: 很遗憾，这是不可能的，因为我已经和{s0}订婚了。

column2: Unfortunately this is impossible, since you are already engaged to {s0}.
column3: 很遗憾，这是不可能的，因为你已经和{s0}订婚了。

column2: It is our custom to seal any such alliances with marriage. You have made quite a few waves since your arrival, and I might be willing to consider such an arrangement, but unfortunately no one in my household is eligible to wed.
column3: 通过联姻来巩固这样的联盟是我们的传统。你来到这里以后闹出了不小的动静，我也许愿意考虑这样的安排，但很不幸，我们家没有适婚的人。

column2: You will not take offense if I tell you that, as a {s0}, I have other plans for my children.
column3: 作为{s0}，我对自己的孩子另有安排，我这么说希望你不要生气。

column2: May I {s15}suggest that I be considered as a {groom/bride}?
column3: 我能{s15}提议把我当作{新郎/新娘}人选吗？

column2: I must say, though. You live your life like a {woman/man}, riding where you will, with the company you choose. This will not make it easy for the other {s0} to accept our marriage. I don't suppose that you would give up adventuring, for the sake of our marriage?
column3: 不过我得说，你过着{女人/男人}般的生活，想去哪就去哪，想和谁结伴就和谁结伴。这会让其他{s0}很难接受我们的婚事。为了我们的婚姻，你恐怕不会放弃冒险生涯吧？

column2: Very well, then. As there are no obstacles to our marriage, should we then consider ourselves engaged to be wed? I will organize a great feast, and we can exchange our vows before all the {s0} of the realm. If you are willing, that is...
column3: 很好，既然我们的婚姻已经没有任何阻碍了，我们就算订婚了吧？我会筹办一场盛大的宴会，然后我们可以在王国所有的{s0}面前交换誓约。当然，前提是你愿意……

column2: Take whatever time you need, my {lord/lady}.
column3: 你需要多少时间都可以，我的{大人/女士}。

column2: I am not commanding any {reg65?soldiers:men} at the moment.
column3: 我目前没有带领任何{reg65?士兵:人马}。

column2: I would be glad to fight at your side, my friend, but there is a problem...The thing is, I've found myself in a bit of debt that I must repay very soon. {reg6} denars altogether,and I am honour-bound to return every coin. Unless you've got {reg6} denars with you that you can spare,I've to keep my mind on getting this weight off my neck.
column3: 我很乐意与你并肩作战，我的朋友，但有个问题……我欠了别人一些钱，很快就得还，一共{reg6}第纳尔，我以名誉担保要一分不少地还清。除非你能拿出{reg6}第纳尔给我，否则我只能一心想着怎么卸下这个包袱。

column2: Ah . . . Very well, {playername}. Much as I dislike losing good men,the decision is yours. I'll disband my troops and join you.
column3: 嗯 … … 好 吧 ， {playername}。 虽 然 我 不 喜 欢 失 去 优 秀 的 手 下 ， 这 事 还 由 你 作 主 。 我 会 解 散 我 的 人 ， 然 后 加 入 你 。

column2: Excellent.My lads and I will ride with you.
column3: 太好了。我和我的弟兄们会跟你一起走。

column2: Very well then.I shall maintain a patrol of this area. Return if you have further orders for me.
column3: 好 的 ， 我 会 带 着 我 的 人 在 这 一 带 巡 逻 。 如 果 你 有 下 一 步 的 指 令 ， 就 来 找 我 好 了 。

column2: What pigswill!And to think I would offer you a place among my nobles. Begone, beggar, before I lose my temper!
column3: 少 痴 人 说 梦 了 ！ 你 认 为 我 会 封 你 为 贵 族 ？ 趁 我 还 没 发 火 快 滚 吧 ， 乞 丐 ！

column2: My {lord/lady}, you seem to have the makings of a good war leader. For a {man/woman} to show such skill is an uncommon thing in Calradia, but not completely without precedent. Noble{men/women} have often taken command of armies after their {wives/husbands} or {mothers/fathers} were slain or captured, for example.
column3: 我的{大人/女士}，你似乎具备成为一名优秀将领的素质。在卡拉迪亚，一个{男人/女人}展现出这样的才能并不多见，但也不是没有先例。比如，贵族{男子/女子}常常在{妻子/丈夫}或{母亲/父亲}战死或被俘之后接掌军队。

column2: However, I have never heard of a {s0} who granted a fief to a {man/woman}, no matter how valorous, simply because {reg65?she:he} needed an extra vassal. Were I to do such a thing, I would raise eyebrows across Calradia. {People/Men} would say that I was besotted or bewitched, or that I aimed to overturn the natural order of things. As much as I regret it, I cannot afford to grant you a fief.
column3: 然而，我从来没有听说过哪位{s0}仅仅因为需要多一个封臣，就把封地赐给一个{男人/女人}，无论{reg65?她:他}多么英勇。如果我这么做了，整个卡拉迪亚都会侧目而视。{人们/男人们}会说我被迷住了、中了邪，或者说我想颠覆天经地义的秩序。尽管我很遗憾，但我不能给你封地。

column2: Well, I still would not be willing to grant you any fiefs. However, you would no doubt have the use of your {wife/husband}'s properties, which would allow you to act as one of my vassals in all but name. Did you have an other questions?
column3: 这么说吧，我还是不愿意给你任何封地。不过，毫无疑问你可以使用你{妻子/丈夫}的产业，这样你除了没有封臣的名义，实际上就和我的封臣一样了。你还有其他问题吗？

column2: You are known as a brave {man-at-arms/warrior} and a fine leader of men, {playername}. I shall be pleased to accept your {s0} into my service and bestow vassalage upon you, if you are ready to swear homage to me.
column3: 你是出了名的勇敢{武士/战士}，也是一位出色的统帅，{playername}。如果你准备好向我宣誓效忠，我很乐意接纳你的{s0}为我效力，并册封你为封臣。

column2: You've yet to show yourself as a competent commander, {playername}. Take your {s0} to my enemies and prove to me that you are worthy of becoming my vassal. Then we may speak more of this.
column3: 你还没有证明自己是一名称职的指挥官，{playername}。拿起你的{s0}去对付我的敌人，向我证明你配成为我的封臣。到那时我们再详谈。

column2: So be it, {s0}. May all my vassals be as valiant and loyal as you.
column3: 那就这样吧，{s0}。愿我所有的封臣都像你一样英勇忠诚。

column2: I have great hopes for you {playername}.I know you shall prove yourself worthy of the trust I have placed in you.
column3: 我 对 你 抱 有 很 大 的 期 望 ， {playername}。 我 知 道 你 不 会 辜 负 我 的 信 任 的 。

column2: Heh, a wise move,{playername}. With loyal service, a {man/woman} in my service could become wealthy and powerful,and our enemies... Well, our enemies are as wheat before a scythe.However, to enter my service you must first renounce all worldly oaths and bonds,and swear to serve only the {s5}.
column3: 嘿，明智之举，{playername}。只要忠心效力，为我效劳的{人/人}就能获得财富和权力，而我们的敌人……嗯，我们的敌人就像镰刀下的麦子。不过，要为我效力，你必须先断绝一切世俗的誓约和羁绊，宣誓只为{s5}效力。

column2: Are you having me on? I've no time for games, {playername}.Make up your mind and stop wasting my time.
column3: 你 在 戏 弄 我 吗 ？ 我 没 有 时 间 跟 你 儿 戏 ， {playername}。 现 在 就 决 定 ， 不 要 浪 费 我 的 时 间 ！

column2: Then it is my pleasure to welcome you to the service of my house. From this day on, {playername},you are a soldier of the {s5} with all the duties and privileges that come with it.
column3: 我 非 常 高 兴 地 欢 迎 你 效 力 于 我 的 王 庭 。 从 现 在 开 始 ， {playername}， 你 拥 有 作 为 一 名 {s5}战 士 的 一 切 职 责 和 特 权 。

column2: I charge you with rooting out and destroying the forces of our enemies wherever you may find them.Moreover, I will have special tasks for you from time to time, as may some of my other vassal lords.Serve, fight, and honour your oaths. These things will take you far, if you've a mind for promotion.May God grant us long lives and many victories to toast in my hall!
column3: 我 命 你 承 担 起 消 灭 一 切 所 见 敌 人 的 责 任 。 并 且 我 以 及 其 他 受 封 于 我 的 领 主 将 不 时 指 派 你 特 别 的 任 务 。 效 力 ， 战 斗 ， 维 护 你 誓 言 的 荣 誉 。 你 若 有 心 升 迁 ， 这 些 将 对 你 助 益 良 多 。 愿 神 赐 予 我 们 长 寿 与 胜 利 。

column2: Hrm.Has your oath become burdensome, {playername}? It is unusual to request release from homage,but in respect of your fine service, I will not hold you if you truly wish to end it.Though you would be sorely missed.
column3: 嗯 。 你 觉 得 这 份 誓 言 太 沉 重 了 么 ， {playername}？ 解 除 誓 约 的 事 并 不 常 见 ， 但 是 鉴 于 你 为 我 工 作 的 很 好 ， 如 果 你 真 的 想 要 结 束 它 ， 我 不 会 强 留 你 。 但 我 会 很 怀 念 你 的 。

column2: Release from homage? Hmm, perhaps it would be for the best...However, {playername}, you must be sure that release is what you desire. This is not a thing done lightly.
column3: 解 除 誓 言 ？ 嗯 。 也 许 这 样 是 最 好 的 结 果 … … 但 是 ， {playername}， 你 必 须 要 确 定 你 是 真 的 非 常 希 望 这 么 做 ， 因 为 这 可 不 是 一 件 小 事 。

column2: I am pleased to hear it, {playername}.I hope you'll banish such unworthy thoughts from your mind from now on.
column3: 我 非 常 高 兴 听 到 这 个 ， {playername}。 以 后 别 再 考 虑 这 些 不 着 边 际 的 事 。

column2: As you wish. I hereby declare your oaths to be null and void.You will no longer hold land or titles in my name, and you are released from your duties to my house.You are free, {playername}.
column3: 如 你 所 愿 。 我 在 此 宣 布 你 的 誓 言 作 废 了 ， 你 已 经 不 再 拥 有 我 名 下 的 土 地 和 头 衔 了 ， 并 且 解 除 你 在 我 王 庭 的 职 务 。 你 现 在 自 由 了 ， {playername}。

column2: These {reg13?brave women:skilled men} may well turn the tide in my plans, {playername}. I am confident you've trained them well. My thanks and my compliments to you.
column3: 照我的计划，这些{reg13?勇敢的女兵:精干的士兵}很可能会扭转局面，{playername}。我相信你把他们训练得很好。向你致以感谢和赞赏。

column2: Well, the {reg13?gals:lads} are at your command now, sir. I am sure you will take good care of them.
column3: 好了，这些{reg13?姑娘:小伙子}现在归你指挥了，大人。我相信你会好好照顾他们的。
我在{s3}找到了躲藏起来的{s4}……

column2: Good. I trust you followed my instructions to the letter?
column3: 很好。我相信你完全按照我的指示办了吧？

column2: Of course. I gave him his punishment.
column3: 当然。我已经给了他应有的惩罚。

column2: I apprehended {s4} and brought him here to see justice done.
column3: 我抓住了{s4}，把他带到这里接受审判。

column2: I caught {s4} but he slipped his bonds along the way...
column3: 我抓住了{s4}，可他在半路上挣脱了绳索……

column2: I found the fugitive at {s3} and burnt down that nest of corruption.
column3: 我在{s3}找到了逃犯，还烧掉了那个藏污纳垢的地方。

column2: I'm afraid somebody else torched down {s3}. I was unable to trace his family.
column3: 恐怕有别人把{s3}烧光了。我没能找到他的家人。

column2: You pillaged an entire village to get at one man?! I dare say that {s10} will not be pleased... We've killed two birds with one stone today haven't we, {playername}?
column3: 你为了抓一个人，竟然洗劫了整个村子？！我敢说{s10}不会高兴的……我们今天可真是一箭双雕啊，对吧，{playername}？

column2: Are you out of your mind, {playername}? {reg10?Those were my peasants you buffoon:That village belonged to my {s11}}! {reg11?If this is the sort of behaviour I can expect from you, I worry for the future of our realm:I should have known better than to trust someone as zealous as yourself}. Take this blood money and begone...
column3: 你疯了吗，{playername}？{reg10?那些是我的农民，你这个蠢货:那个村子属于我的{s11}}！{reg11?如果这就是我能指望你的行事方式，我真为我们王国的未来担忧:我早该知道不能相信像你这样狂热的人}。拿着这笔血钱滚吧……

column2: But why?! I suppose you did your job, although your methods are questionable at best...
column3: 可这是为什么？！我想你算是完成了任务，尽管你的手段实在令人怀疑……

column2: I am truly displeased, {playername}. {reg10?Could there truly be somebody as incompetent as you?:} I told you to kill {s4}, not to make a mockery of defending my honour only to lose the bastard. What a fine mess you've made of things now...{reg11? Or perhaps you let loose his bonds on purpose to spite me?:}
column3: 我真的很不满意，{playername}。{reg10?难道真有像你这么无能的人吗？:}我让你杀了{s4}，不是让你假装捍卫我的荣誉，最后却让那个混蛋跑掉。看看你现在把事情搞得多糟……{reg11?或者你是故意放了他来跟我作对？:}

column2: Very well. Thanks to your actions, justice will be done at last. You will have my gratitude and a purse of 300 denars as promised.
column3: 很好。多亏了你，正义终于得以伸张。你将得到我的感激，以及我答应过的300第纳尔。

column2: Excellent, {playername}. I'll have to sharpen my knives before I can start work on {s4}. Ah, yes, I suppose you'll want the bounty...
column3: 很好，{playername}。在开始收拾{s4}之前，我得先把刀磨快。啊，对了，我想你是要赏金吧……

column2: Good. Off with his head! I knew you wouldn't fail me, {playername}, here is your reward of 300 denars.
column3: 很好。砍下他的脑袋！我就知道你不会让我失望，{playername}，这是你的300第纳尔赏金。

column2: Well, I suppose the fates intervened to take that revenge from me. Although I would have liked to see that {s43}'s corpse myself, I'll have to take your word for it.
column3: 好吧，我想是命运插手，夺走了我复仇的机会。虽然我很想亲眼看看那个{s43}的尸体，但也只好相信你的话了。

column2: Only my loyal vassals can own lands and castles in my realm -- and all my vassals are {women/men}. I am not inclined to depart from this tradition without a very good reason. If you prove yourself in battle, you can swear an oath of homage to me and become my vassal. We may then discuss how you may obtain a castle.
column3: 在我的王国里，只有我忠诚的封臣才能拥有领地和城堡——而我所有的封臣都是{女人/男人}。没有非常充分的理由，我不打算打破这个传统。如果你在战斗中证明了自己，你可以宣誓效忠于我，成为我的封臣。到那时我们再讨论你怎样才能得到一座城堡。

column2: Hmm... Only loyal vassals of {s10} can own lands and castles. While {s0} will sometimes accept vassalage from {men/women} who prove themselves in battle, and grant them land, I have never heard of a {s1} who gave fiefs to {men/women}. You had best discuss that issue with {s10} {reg0?herself:himself}.
column3: 嗯……只有{s10}忠诚的封臣才能拥有领地和城堡。虽然{s0}有时会接受那些在战斗中证明了自己的{男人/女人}成为封臣，并赐给他们土地，但我从没听说过哪位{s1}把封地给了{男人/女人}。你最好跟{s10}{reg0?她本人:他本人}去谈这个问题。

column2: Only loyal vassals of {s10} can own lands and castles. You understand, a simple mercenary cannot be trusted with such responsibility. However, after serving for some time, you may earn the right to swear homage to {s10} and become {reg0?her:his} vassal. Then you would be rewarded with a fief.
column3: 只有{s10}忠诚的封臣才能拥有城堡和领地。你知道，一个普通的雇佣兵不能被委以如此重任。不过，效力一段时间以后，你也许能获得向{s10}宣誓效忠的资格，成为{reg0?她:他}的封臣，到那时你就会得到一块封地作为奖赏。

column2: Only noble vassals of {s10} have the honour of carrying their own banners. However, after some time of mercenary service, perhaps you can earn the opportunity to swear homage to {s10} and become {reg0?her:his} vassal, gaining the right to choose a banner of your own and fight under it in battle.
column3: 只有{s10}的贵族封臣才有打出自己旗帜的荣耀。不过，经过一段时间的雇佣兵服役，你也许能赢得向{s10}宣誓效忠、成为{reg0?她:他}封臣的机会，从而获得选择自己的旗帜并在旗下作战的权利。

column2: My {lord/lady}, by the traditions of courtship, I should be offering my services to you. Unfortunately, I have little time right now, so I beg you to take this declaration of my esteem in its place.
column3: 我的{大人/女士}，按照求爱的传统，我应该为你效劳。不巧的是，我现在没多少时间，所以恳请你收下我的这份敬意作为代替。

column2: There are some minor errands which I need completed, but it would be more appropriate to give them to one of my own {reg65?servants:men}, not to {reg0?my sworn liege:a sworn vassal of the realm}.
column3: 我有一些小差事需要人去办，不过它们更适合交给我手下的某个{reg65?仆人:人}去做，而不是{reg0?我宣誓效忠的君主:本国宣誓效忠的封臣}。

column2: If you are looking for action against our foes, you may join our attack on {s4}. The enemy may come in force to oppose us, so it is good to have as many {reg65?soldiers:{soldiers/men}} as possible.
column3: 如果你想对我们的敌人采取行动，可以加入我们对{s4}的进攻。敌人可能会大举来犯，所以{reg65?士兵:{士兵/人手}}越多越好。

column2: My {s11}, {s13}, has been taken prisoner by {s14} of the {s15}. Normally, honorable nobles will grant prisoners of gentle blood the privilege of parole, and treat them as honored guests so long as they give their word that they will not attempt to escape, until such time as a ransom can be paid. But {s14}, instead of granting {s13} parole, has consigned my {s11} to {reg3?her:his} dungeons -- no doubt in the hope that {reg3?she:he} can demand more from us.
column3: 我的{s11}{s13}被{s15}的{s14}俘虏了。一般来说，高尚的贵族会准许出身高贵的俘虏假释，只要他们保证不试图逃跑，就把他们当作贵宾款待，直到赎金付清为止。但是{s14}不但不准{s13}假释，还把我的{s11}关进了{reg3?她:他}的地牢——毫无疑问，{reg3?她:他}是想向我们勒索更多的赎金。

column2: We need you to get my {s11} out of prison. You may be able to pay a ransom -- in which case I could cover your expenses, up to 2000 denars. If you have connections within {s24}, you may be able to use them to sneak {reg4?her:him} out. Or, you may try a more direct approach -- walk up to the gaoler, take the keys by force, and then fight your way out. Can you do this for us?
column3: 我们需要你把我的{s11}从监狱里救出来。你可以支付赎金——那样的话，我可以为你承担最多2000第纳尔的费用。如果你在{s24}有门路，可以利用这些关系把{reg4?她:他}偷偷救出来。或者，你也可以试试更直接的办法——走到狱卒面前，用武力夺走钥匙，然后杀出一条血路。你能帮我们这个忙吗？

column2: I am thinking of paying the ransom.
I am thinking of using my connections in {s24}.
column3: 我打算利用我在{s24}的门路。

column2: Of course. If my missives to {s14} were not persuasive enough, there is always the merit of amassing more gold. If that fails, I'm sure you could convince the dungeon-keeper or petition a ransom-broker on our behalf. I'm sure other members of our family would be willing to contribute to {s13}'s ransom fund in that case.
column3: 当然。如果我写给{s14}的信还不够有说服力，多凑些金子总是有用的。如果还不行，我相信你可以说服地牢看守，或者替我们去找赎金掮客。我相信到时候我们家族的其他成员也会愿意为{s13}的赎金出一份力。

column2: Well said, {playername}. If you or your companions know the layout of {s24}, then a distraction can certainly be arranged and during the ensuing chaos the locks can be cut with the proper tools. However, whomever we send to rescue {s13} must be fleet of foot and have an agile mind to cajole or hire locals to effect the rescue.
column3: 说得好，{playername}。如果你或你的同伴熟悉{s24}的布局，就一定可以制造混乱，趁乱用合适的工具撬开锁。不过，我们派去营救{s13}的人必须脚步轻快、头脑灵活，才能哄骗或雇用当地人来完成营救。

column2: I need to send a letter to {s13} who should be currently at {s4}. If you will be heading towards there, would you deliver it to {reg0?her:him}? The letter needs to be in {reg0?her:his} hands in 30 days.
column3: 我需要送一封信给{s13}，{reg0?她:他}现在应该在{s4}。如果你正好要去那里，能帮我把信交给{reg0?她:他}吗？这封信需要在30天内送到{reg0?她:他}手里。

column2: I am no errand {boy/girl}, {reg65?my lady:sir}. Hire a courier for your trivialities.
column3: 我不是跑腿的{小子/丫头}，{reg65?夫人:大人}。这种小事你雇个信使去办吧。

column2: I appreciate it, {playername}. Here's the letter, and a small sum to cover your travel expenses. Give my regards to {s13} when you see {reg0?her:him}.
column3: 非常感谢，{playername}。给你信，还有一点盘缠。见到{s13}的时候，替我向{reg0?她:他}问好。

column2: I need to deliver a letter to {s13} of {s15}, who must be at {s4} currently. If you are going towards there, would you deliver my letter to {reg0?her:him}? The letter needs to reach {reg0?her:him} in 40 days.
column3: 我需要送一封信给{s15}的{s13}，{reg0?她:他}现在应该在{s4}。如果你正好要去那个方向，能帮我把信交给{reg0?她:他}吗？这封信需要在40天内送到{reg0?她:他}手里。

column2: There is a small thing... My {s17} {s13} is due for a visit to {reg4?her:his} relatives at {s14}. The visit has been postponed several times already with all the trouble on the roads, but this time {reg4?he:she} is adamant about going. So, I want to at least make sure {reg4?she:he}'s well-guarded. I trust you well, {playername} so I would be very grateful if you could escort {reg4?her:him} to {s14} and make sure {reg4?she:he} arrives safe and sound.
column3: 只是件小事……我的{s17}{s13}要去{s14}探望{reg4?她:他}的亲戚。由于路上不太平，这次探亲已经推迟了好几次，但这一次{reg4?她:他}执意要去。所以，我至少要确保{reg4?她:他}有人好好护卫。我很信任你，{playername}，如果你能护送{reg4?她:他}到{s14}，确保{reg4?她:他}平安抵达，我会非常感激。

column2: A group of bandits have taken refuge in my village of {s15}. They are plundering nearby farms, and getting rich and fat stealing my taxes and feasting on my cattle. I'd like nothing better than to go out there and teach them a lesson, but I have my hands full at the moment, so I can't do anything about it.
column3: 一 伙 强 盗 把 我 的 领 地 {s15}当 作 了 避 难 所 ， 他 们 劫 掠 附 近 的 农 田 ， 用 属 于 我 的 税 金 和 牲 口 养 肥 自 己 。 如 果 不 是 现 在 我 已 经 忙 得 脱 不 开 身 ， 我 一 定 要 给 他 们 一 个 永 生 难 忘 的 教 训 。

column2: No {reg65?lady:lord} should have to admit this, {playername}, but I was inspecting my soldiers the other day and there are {reg0?{reg65?women:soldiers}:{reg65?soldiers:men}} here who don't know which end of a {s42} to hold. {s43} You are a warrior of renown, {playername}. Will you train some troops for me? I would be grateful to you.
column3: 作为一个{reg65?女领主:领主}，这说起来很丢人，{playername}，前两天我检阅士兵的时候，发现这里有些{reg0?{reg65?女兵:士兵}:{reg65?士兵:家伙}}连{s42}该拿哪一头都不知道。{s43}你是一位声名远扬的战士，{playername}。你能帮我训练一些士兵吗？我会非常感激你的。

column2: How many soldiers do you need?

I have good information that a {reg3?woman:man} in this very town is actually an enemy spy. {reg3?She:He} should be seized and hanged for {reg3?his:her} impudence, but we also believe that very soon {reg3?she:he} will leave town to meet with {reg3?her:his} master, the man to whom the spy feeds all {reg3?her:his} little whispers. The spy himself is of little import, but the master is a dangerous man, and could tell us a great deal if we could only get our hands on him...
column3: 我得到可靠消息，就在这座城里有一个{reg3?女人:人}其实是敌人的间谍。{reg3?她:他}这样胆大妄为，应该被抓起来吊死，但我们也相信{reg3?她:他}很快就会离开城镇，去和{reg3?她:他}的上线接头，那个间谍把所有的小道消息都报告给这个人。间谍本人无足轻重，但那个上线是个危险人物，只要我们能抓住他，就能从他嘴里得到很多情报……

column2: I want you to wait here until the spy leaves town. Then you must follow {reg3?her:him}, stealthily, to the meeting place. You must take absolute care not to be seen by the spy on your way, else {reg3?she:he} may suspect foul play and turn back. When the master appears, you must ambush and arrest them and bring the pair back to me. Alive, if you please.
column3: 我要你在这里等到那个间谍离开城镇。然后你必须悄悄地跟着{reg3?她:他}到接头地点。一路上你千万要小心，不能被间谍发现，否则{reg3?她:他}可能会起疑心而折返。等那个上线出现时，你必须伏击并抓住他们，把两人都带回来见我。最好是活的。

column2: Good, I'm sure you'll do a fine job of it. One of my men will point the spy out to you when {reg3?she:he} leaves, so you will know the man to follow. Remember, I want them both, and I want them alive.
column3: 很好，我相信你一定会漂亮地完成任务。那个间谍离城的时候，我的一个手下会把{reg3?她:他}指给你看，这样你就知道该跟踪谁了。记住，我两个都要，而且要活的。

column2: Some time ago, I loaned out a considerable sum of money to {s3}. {reg4} denars, to be precise. {reg0?She:He} was supposed to pay it back within a month but I haven't received a copper from {reg0?her:him} since. That was months ago. If you could collect the debt from {reg0?her:him} on my behalf, I would be grateful indeed. I would even let you keep one fifth of the money for your trouble. What do you say?
column3: 前些时候，我借给{s3}一大笔钱。确切地说，是{reg4}第纳尔。{reg0?她:他}本应在一个月内还给我，可从那以后我连一个铜板都没收到。那已经是几个月前的事了。如果你能代我向{reg0?她:他}讨回这笔债，我会非常感激。我甚至可以让你留下五分之一作为酬劳。你意下如何？

column2: If you leave now, you should be able to find {reg0?her:him} at {s4}. I've no doubt that {reg0?she:he} will be suitably embarassed by {reg0?her:his} conduct and give you all the money {reg0?she:he} owes me.
column3: 如果你现在出发，应该能在{s4}找到{reg0?她:他}。我毫不怀疑，{reg0?她:他}会为自己的行为感到羞愧，把欠我的钱如数交给你。

column2: You made me very happy by accepting this {playername}. Please, talk to {s3} and don't leave {reg0?her:him} without my money.
column3: 你愿意帮这个忙，我很高兴，{playername}。请去和{s3}谈谈，拿不到我的钱就别放过{reg0?她:他}。

column2: I tell you, that blubbering fool {s13} is not fit to rule {s14}. God knows {reg3?she:he} would be divested of {reg3?her:his} lands in an instant were it not for one of {reg3?her:his} loyal vassals, {s15}. As long as {reg3?she:he} has {reg3?her:his} vassal aiding {reg3?her:him}, it will be a difficult job beating {reg3?her:him}. So I need to get {s15} out of the picture, and I have a plan just to do that... With your help, naturally.
column3: 我告诉你，{s13}那个哭哭啼啼的蠢货根本不配统治{s14}。天知道，要不是有{reg3?她:他}的忠实封臣{s15}，{reg3?她:他}早就丢光了自己的领地。只要那个封臣还在辅佐{reg3?她:他}，要打败{reg3?她:他}就很困难。所以我得把{s15}除掉，而我正好有个计划……当然，需要你的帮助。

column2: I have written a fake letter to {s15}, bearing my own seal, which implicates {reg4?her:him} in a conspiracy with us to stage a coup in {s14}, in my favor. If we can make {s13} believe the letter is genuine, {reg3?she:he} will deal with {s15} very swiftly. Of course, the challenge there is to convince {s13} that the letter is indeed real...
column3: 我写了一封伪造的信给{s15}，盖着我自己的印章，信里牵连{reg4?她:他}与我们合谋在{s14}发动一场对我有利的政变。如果我们能让{s13}相信这封信是真的，{reg3?她:他}很快就会对付{s15}。当然，难就难在怎样让{s13}相信这封信确实是真的……

column2: This is where you come into play. You'll take the letter to {s14}, then give it to one of your soldiers and instruct {reg4?her:him} to take it to {s15}. I will have one of my spies inform the town garrison so that your {reg4?girl:man} will be arrested on his way. The guards will then find the letter and take it to {s13}. They'll torture your {reg4?woman:man}, of course, to try and get the truth out of {reg4?her:him}, but all {reg4?she:he} knows is that you ordered the letter to be delivered to {s15} under the utmost secrecy. {s13} knows you serve me, and the fool will certainly believe the whole charade.
column3: 这就是你要扮演的角色。你把这封信带到{s14}，然后交给你的一名士兵，让{reg4?她:他}送去给{s15}。我会让我的一个密探去通知城里的驻军，这样你的{reg4?姑娘:人}就会在路上被捕。守卫们会搜出这封信，然后呈给{s13}。当然，他们会拷打你的{reg4?女兵:士兵}，想从{reg4?她:他}嘴里逼出真相，但{reg4?她:他}唯一知道的就是你下令将这封信秘密送给{s15}。{s13}知道你为我效力，那个蠢货一定会相信这整出戏。

column2: There is one more thing... Your messenger must be someone trustworthy. If you sent the letter with a simple peasant, someone expendable, {s13} might suspect a plot. {reg3?She:He} may have the wits of a snail, but even a snail can see the obvious. Give the letter to someone of rank. One of your {s9}, perhaps.
column3: 还有一件事……你的信使必须是个值得信赖的人。如果你让一个普通农民、一个无足轻重的人去送信，{s13}可能会怀疑其中有诈。{reg3?她:他}也许笨得像只蜗牛，但就算是蜗牛也看得出显而易见的事。把信交给一个有身份的人，比如你的一个{s9}。

column2: What? I can't send one of my trusted {s9} to {reg4?her:his} death!
column3: 什么？我不能把我信任的{s9}送上{reg4?她:他}的死路！

column2: No, I'll not sacrifice one of my {reg4?sworn women:chosen men}.
column3: 不，我绝不会牺牲我的{reg4?宣誓女兵:亲选战士}。

column2: What is it, {s0}? I still need to finish my job.
column3: 什么事，{s0}？我还得完成我的任务。

column2: As you are my chief minister, I wish to speak to about affairs of state.
column3: 你是我的首席大臣，我想和你谈谈国家大事。

column2: Let us think of a way to improve our standing in this realm.
column3: 让我们想个办法来提高我们在这个王国中的地位。

column2: My {reg65?wife:husband}, I would like to dedicate my successes in this recent tournament to you
column3: 我的{reg65?妻子:丈夫}，我想把我在这次比武大会上的胜利献给你

column2: I was thinking that perhaps we could host a feast?
column3: 我在想，也许我们可以举办一场宴会？

column2: Let us take inventory of our household possessions.
column3: 让我们清点一下府中的财物。

column2: I would like you to join my retinue.
column3: 我希望你加入我的随从。

column2: Really?  You'd ask me to ride with your band like the old stories? To be with you in the field and watch your back in the wars?  I've dreamed about this since I was a little girl!  To see those dreams realized in this modern world would be so amazing! I shall make ready at once!  Thank you so much, {s0}!
column3: 真的吗？你要我像古老的故事里那样，跟着你的队伍一起策马出征？在战场上陪伴你，在战争中守护你的后背？我从小就梦想着这一天！在如今这个世道能让梦想成真，真是太棒了！我这就去准备！太感谢你了，{s0}！

column2: You want me to ride with you into the wars?  I've read such things in books and heard the minstrel's tales of women fighting alongside the men. And I know there are some common women swept up into the wars who fight as Sword Sisters or serve as camp followers. But I never thought such an opportunity could come to me. I've never seen a battle up close -- except in the arena of course -- and the thought of having a man rush me with a raised ax terrifies me.^^Still -- to sleep under the stars with {s0}, to see the world, to ride to victory on a gallant steed... these are opportunities rarely offered to women. I would be doing my sex a disservice not to seize upon it. I will come with you.
column3: 你要我随你一起奔赴战场？我在书里读到过，也听吟游诗人讲过女人与男人并肩作战的故事。我也知道有些平民女子卷入战争，成了持剑姐妹，或者当了随营人员。但我从没想过这样的机会会降临到我身上。我从没近距离见过战斗——当然，竞技场里的除外——一想到有个男人举着斧头向我冲过来，我就害怕。^^不过——能和{s0}一起露宿星空之下，见识世界，骑着骏马奔向胜利……这样的机会很少会给女人。如果不抓住它，那就辜负了我们女人。我会跟你走。

column2: Of course, {s0}! It would be my pleasure. I do wonder what I should wear for this outing... Perhaps we can shop together sometime?
column3: 当然，{s0}！我很乐意。我在想这次出行该穿什么好……也许我们什么时候可以一起去逛逛？

column2: Ride out with you to the wars? I must confess to being tempted, if only to see to it that you and your men refrain from the vices to which your sex is susceptible, such as drinking and wenching and plundering and slaughtering prisoners. But I am a woman, a lady of noble lineage, and for a Calradian woman, riding out to war is just not to be done.^^It is not my place. My place is here, maintaining your household and protecting your interests in your absence, and ensuring your hearth is warmed when you return.^^That is my role as a woman, and I am content.
column3: 和你一起奔赴战场？我得承认我有点心动，哪怕只是为了确保你和你的手下不沾染你们男人容易染上的恶习，比如酗酒、嫖妓、劫掠和屠杀俘虏。但我是个女人，一位出身高贵的女士，对卡拉迪亚的女人来说，骑马出征是万万不可的。^^那不是我该待的地方。我的位置在这里，在你不在的时候打理你的家务、守护你的利益，并确保你回来时炉火温暖。^^这是我作为女人的职责，我对此心满意足。

column2: What? Ride to the wars like a common camp follower? Spend my days in slaughter like some harlot of a Sword Sister? You presume a great deal, {s0}. I am not some common tavern drek or tomboy mercenary. I am a Lady of Calradia, brought up from birth to assist my husband in the ruling of the household and lands. I seek my glory in the deeds of my husband. Not in my own.^^For me to play a man's part would cheapen me and subject me to the scorn and contempt of every highborn Calradian. I do not take this suggestion kindly and I do not wish to be asked again.
column3: 什么？像个普通的随营女人那样奔赴战场？像某个持剑姐妹的娼妇那样天天杀戮？你也太放肆了，{s0}。我不是什么酒馆里的下贱女人，也不是男人婆雇佣兵。我是卡拉迪亚的贵妇，从出生起就被教导要协助丈夫治理家庭和领地。我的荣耀在于我丈夫的功业，而不在于我自己的。^^让我去扮演男人的角色，只会贬低我的身份，让我受到每一位卡拉迪亚贵族的鄙视和轻蔑。我很不喜欢这个提议，也不希望你再问我。

column2: Oh, {s0}, why do you ask me this? I couldn't ride into battle with you! I've never held a sword in my life! I'd be worse than hopeless! Few Calradians of noble lineage teach their daughters to fight and I'm not sure I would have learned to fight even I'd been given the opportunity. The weakest recruit in your army has more virtue in a fight than I, who have never wielded any weapon deadlier than an embroidery needle. I would get your men killed trying to protect me.^^You are my {s0} and I respect you, but if you wanted a wife who was going to be able to stand with you shoulder to shoulder, shield to shield -- you should have married someone else.
column3: 哦，{s0}，你为什么要问我这个？我不可能和你一起上战场！我这辈子从没拿过剑！我会比一无是处还糟糕！卡拉迪亚的贵族很少教女儿打仗，就算给了我机会，我也不确定自己能学会。你军队里最弱的新兵在战斗中都比我有用，我拿过的最致命的武器不过是一根绣花针。你的手下会为了保护我而送命。^^你是我的{s0}，我尊敬你，但如果你想要一个能与你肩并肩、盾并盾的妻子——你就该娶别人。

column2: A splendid idea, {s0}. However, let us wait for the current feast here to conclude, before organizing another.
column3: 绝妙的主意，{s0}。不过，让我们先等这里的这场宴会结束，再筹办下一场吧。

column2: A splendid idea, {s0}. However, we must establish a court before hosting a feast.
column3: 绝妙的主意，{s0}。不过，我们得先建立宫廷才能举办宴会。

column2: A splendid idea, {s0}. However, our realm has recently had a feast. Perhaps we should wait another {reg3} days before we organize another one.
column3: 绝妙的主意，{s0}。不过，我们的王国最近刚举办过一场宴会。也许我们应该再等{reg3}天再筹办下一场。

column3: 是的，我显然有要紧的事要办。

column2: Very well. We'll be moving on to {s12}. Enjoy the ride, {s0}, but keep your eye out for brigands...
column3: 很好。我们要前往{s12}了。路上愉快，{s0}，不过要当心强盗……
告 诉 我 你 们 的 行 程

column2: No, I want everything you have!
An escort? We're almost at {s10} already! Thank you for the offer, though.
column3: 护送？我们都快到{s10}了！不过还是谢谢你的好意。

column2: Good day, {s0}. Will you be visiting the prison?
column3: 你好，{s0}。您要去看看监狱吗？

column2: You've been lax in your duties. Stand down and I'll choose your replacement.
column3: 你玩忽职守。退下吧，我会另选人来接替你。

column2: Alright, which prisoner shall I set free?
column3: 好的，我该释放哪名俘虏？

column2: As you wish, I will release {s10} of {s11}.
Relieve yourself, soldier. Somebody else will guard the keep in your stead.
column3: 你歇着吧，士兵。会有别人替你看守主堡。

column2: Get lost before I lose my temper!
Where do you think you're going?
Don't make me laugh. Go back to the dirt where you belong, peasant!
column3: 别逗我笑了。回到你该待的泥地里去吧，乡巴佬！

column2: What?! The lord has no need to speak to poachers. If you must sell your wares, use the servant's door, {man/woman}!
column3: 什么？！大人没必要跟偷猎的人说话。如果你非要卖你的货，走仆人的门去，{伙计/女人}！

column2: Away with you, the lord does not deal with penny-pinching merchants. Speak with the guildmaster if you have business here.
column3: 走开，大人可不跟斤斤计较的商人打交道。如果你在这里有生意要谈，去找行会会长吧。

column2: You have the wrong ideas, friend. Mercenaries have no place in the great hall.
column3: 你想错了，朋友。大厅里没有雇佣兵的位置。

column2: The last minstrel that attempted to gain entrance was chased out of town tarred and feathered. I doubt you wish the same fate.
column3: 上一个想混进去的吟游诗人被涂了柏油、粘上羽毛赶出了城。我想你不希望落得同样的下场。

column2: Wait there. I'll send {reg0?her:him} your request.
column3: 在这里等一下。我会把你的请求转告{reg0?她:他}。

column2: {s2} says {reg0?she:he} will not see you. Begone now.

column3: 让 我 们 换 一 个 话 题

column2: I have nothing against you {reg65?woman:man}. But {s2} wants you dead. Sorry.
column3: 我跟你没有仇，{reg65?女人:伙计}。但是{s2}要你死。对不起了。

column2: You are going to forget about {s2}'s debt to you. And you will sign a paper stating that {reg4?she:he} owes you nothing.
column3: 你要忘掉{s2}欠你的债。而且你要签一份文书，声明{reg4?她:他}什么都不欠你。

column2: There's a trap set up for you in the town. {s3} ordered me to sacrifice one of my chosen warriors to fool the enemy, but {reg3?she:he} will just need to find another way.
column3: 镇上有个为你设好的圈套。{s3}命令我牺牲我的一名亲选战士去迷惑敌人，不过{reg3?她:他}只好另想办法了。

column2: I will reward you and provide protection if you {reg10?enlist in my:rejoin the {s10}} army.
column3: 如果你们{reg10?加入我的:重新加入{s10}的}军队，我会奖赏你们，并为你们提供庇护。

column2: How generous, {s0}. Show us {reg5} denars, then we will consider joining you.
column3: 您真慷慨，{s0}。先给我们看看{reg5}第纳尔，然后我们再考虑加入您。
好吧，这是你们的{reg5}第纳尔。

column2: We are at your service from now on.
column3: 从现在起我们听候您的差遣。

column2: At last! My stock was almost depleted. I have paid the cost of the {s4} in advance, but here, take these {reg5} denars. That should cover your pay. And give that {s9} my regards. I'll put in a good word for you next time I deal with {reg3?her:him}.
column3: 终于来了！我的货都快卖光了。我已经预先付了{s4}的钱，不过，拿着这{reg5}第纳尔吧。这应该够你的报酬了。替我向那位{s9}问好。下次我和{reg3?她:他}打交道时，会替你美言几句的。

column2: I'd like to buy every man who comes in here tonight a jar of your best {s0}.
column3: 我想请今晚来这里的每个人喝一罐你这里最好的{s0}。

column2: With what money, friend? You look like you could barely hold down a meal, let afford a round of drinks.
column3: 用什么钱付，朋友？你看起来连一顿饭都吃不起，更别说请大家喝一轮酒了。

column2: Why {playername}, I do believe that would be a waste of our time. The local boys would dump their perfectly good drinks as soon as they heard it came from you. I think it best if you could find other places to spend your blood money...
column3: 哎呀，{playername}，我觉得那是浪费我们的时间。本地的小伙子们一听说酒是你请的，就会把好好的酒倒掉。我看你最好去别的地方花你那些血汗钱……

column2: No offense, {playername}, but I wouldn't stay in business long if {s1} got word that you're around. In fact, I would caution you to watch your back if you plan on lodging in this town... Who knows what sort of ruffians might show up in the middle of the night?
column3: 别见怪，{playername}，但如果{s1}听说你在这里，我的生意就做不长了。说真的，如果你打算在这个镇上住下，我劝你多提防背后……谁知道半夜会冒出什么样的恶棍？

column2: Of course, {s0}. I reckon {reg5} denars should be enough for that. What should I tell the lads?
column3: 当然，{s0}。我估计{reg5}第纳尔应该够了。我该怎么跟弟兄们说？

column2: Don't worry {s0}. Your name will be cheered and toasted here all night.
column3: 别担心，{s0}。今晚大家整夜都会为你的名字欢呼祝酒。

column2: Hmm... Well, {s10} is often looking for mercenaries to fight in {reg0?her:his} wars.{s9}
column3: 嗯……好吧，{s10}常常在找雇佣兵为{reg0?她:他}打仗。{s9}

column2: Greetings to you, {s0}. You look like someone who should get to know me.
column3: 你好，{s0}。你看起来像是应该认识我的人。

column2: Let's see...  I'll give you {reg0} denars for your {reg1} {reg2?prisoners:prisoner}.  Do we have a deal?
column3: 让我看看……你的{reg1}名{reg2?俘虏:俘虏}，我出{reg0}第纳尔。成交吗？

column2: I wish to ransom one of the nobles in the local dungeons.
column3: 我想赎回关在本地地牢里的一位贵族。

column2: There is nothing more I can do {s0}, those prisoners are already yours to dispose of as you please.
column3: 我没什么能做的了，{s0}，那些俘虏已经归你，随你处置。

column2: Sorry {s0}, even with my influences I fear that {s1} will not welcome your gold.
column3: 抱歉，{s0}，即使凭我的影响力，恐怕{s1}也不会欢迎你的金子。

column2: I am sorry {s0}, as {s1} is inimical to {s2}, I do not believe I am capable of negotiating for the release of a {s3}.
column3: 很抱歉，{s0}，由于{s1}与{s2}敌对，我想我没有能力为一位{s3}谈判获释。

column2: I believe {s11}'s liberty is currently valued at {s1}?
Certainly. I wish to speak to {s11} at once.
I don't think I can pay that just yet.
No need for me to inform you of anything, {s0}. I'm sure {s1} will inform you of these things in more detail than I.
column3: 我没必要告诉你什么，{s0}。我相信{s1}会比我更详细地告诉你这些事。

column2: Well, {s0}, it seems that I have nothing to teach you in this world of politics. But perhaps you would be interested in the lives of others who were... less blessed by providence than yourself shall we say?
column3: 好吧，{s0}，看来在这政治世界里我没什么可教你的。不过，也许你会对其他人的生活感兴趣，他们……可以说没有你这么受上天眷顾？

column2: There are many pretenders in Calradia -- those who are born to the right family, who go around and rally support for their claim over the current king's false cause. With the right sort of support from yourself and a few nudges here and there, they could easily start civil wars and perhaps even replace the king one day. Of course, your claim is equally as good as theirs, and a co-rulership of Calradia isn't unheard of.
column3: 卡拉迪亚有许多王位觊觎者——那些出身于正统家族的人，他们四处奔走，召集支持者，宣扬自己的王位继承权，反对现任国王的伪统。只要得到你适当的支持，再到处推波助澜一番，他们很容易就能挑起内战，甚至有一天取代国王。当然，你的继承权和他们的一样正当，而共同统治卡拉迪亚也并非闻所未闻。

column2: I can reveal this information to you for a small price, let's say 300 denars.
column3: 我可以把这个消息透露给你，只要一点小钱，就算300第纳尔吧。

column2: I am sorry, I'm not really a big fan of their music.
column3: 抱歉，我不太喜欢他们的音乐。

column2: I might have heard some ribald songs recently. For 30 denars, I'll tell you where.
column3: 我最近可能听到过一些下流小调。给我30第纳尔，我就告诉你在哪里。

column2: I am looking for book merchants...
I am sorry I haven't run across any lately.
I might have crossed paths with one or two recently. For 100 denars, I'll tell you where.
column3: 我最近可能遇到过一两个。给我100第纳尔，我就告诉你在哪里。

column2: I am looking for ransom brokers...
I know where they are. For 50 denars, I'll tell you.
column3: 我知道他们在哪里。给我50第纳尔，我就告诉你。

column2: I am looking for one of my former employees...
column3: 我在找我以前的一位属官……

column2: I will send word to {reg0?her:him} that you are looking for {reg0?her:him}.
column3: 我会捎信给{reg0?她:他}，说你在找{reg0?她:他}。

column2: I am afraid I'm not able to help you.
All right. Here is the money.
Never mind, I don't want to know.
Greetings. They say you're the kind of {man/woman} who'd be interested to hear that I travel frequently through the {s17}. I'll tell you all I know for a mere 100 denars.
column3: 你好。听说你是那种会对我常常往来于{s17}感兴趣的{人/人}。只要100第纳尔，我就把我知道的一切都告诉你。

column2: Ah, it's good to see a fellow minstrel!
column3: 啊，能见到一位同行吟游诗人真好！

column2: I believe you already know the poems I am best equipped to teach. However, I believe that you are eager to learn more -- I can also teach you some courtly fashion and the use of the lyre. All yours for the small token price of 1000 denars, as I am hesitant to sell off this antique lyre...
column3: 我想你已经掌握了我最擅长教的那些诗篇。不过，我相信你还想学更多——我也可以教你一些宫廷礼仪和里拉琴的弹法。只要区区1000第纳尔就全归你，毕竟我还舍不得卖掉这把古董里拉琴……
好啊——让我看看你的本事。

column2: {reg0?She:He} is married to you, of course! Clearly, no one would dream that {reg0?she:he} would do anything to engender gossip.
column3: {reg0?她:他}当然是和你结了婚的！显然，没有人会想到{reg0?她:他}会做出任何惹人闲话的事。

column2: {Sir/Lady} -- I will speak bluntly. Most of the {ladies/lords} of this land are looking for a demure {lad/maiden}, whose skin as fair as snow -- and your skin is burnt brown by the sun. They want a {boy/maiden} whose voice is soft as bells -- and your voice is hoarse from commanding {soldiers/men} in battle. Also, athough the {ladies/lords} of Calradia appreciate poems about love, most also want heirs, and few {men/women} can ride and fight while {caring for their children/with child}.
column3: {先生/女士}——恕我直言。这片土地上的大多数{淑女/领主}都在寻找一位端庄的{少年/少女}，皮肤像雪一样白皙——而你的皮肤却被太阳晒得黝黑。他们想要一位声音如银铃般柔和的{少年/少女}——而你的声音却因在战场上指挥{士兵/部下}而变得沙哑。此外，尽管卡拉迪亚的{淑女们/领主们}欣赏爱情诗，但大多数人也想要继承人，而很少有{男人/女人}能在{照顾孩子/怀着孩子}的同时骑马打仗。

column2: However, not all {ladies/lords} will be so conventionally minded. We poets sing of shield {boys/maidens} and of {hunters/huntresses}, of {lads/women} who forged their own path without having sacrificed the chance for love. I would not tell you that it would be easy for you to find a devoted {wife/husband} who will accept your ways, but I would not say that it is impossible.
column3: 不过，并不是所有的{淑女/领主}都这么循规蹈矩。我们诗人歌颂持盾的{少年/少女}和{猎人/女猎手}，歌颂那些走出自己的道路、却没有牺牲爱情的{少年/女子}。我不敢说你能轻易找到一位接受你生活方式的忠贞{妻子/丈夫}，但我也不会说那是不可能的。

column2: {reg0?Your highness:My {lord/lady}}, we are in dire need of assistance.  Will you hear my plea?
column3: {reg0?殿下:我的{大人/夫人}}，我们急需帮助。您能听听我的请求吗？

column2: What is the matter, my good {reg65?woman:man}?
column3: 出什么事了，我的好{reg65?女人:人}？

column2: A band of brigands have taken refuge in our village. They take everything we have, force us to serve them, and do us much evil. If one of us so much as breathes a word of protest, they kill the poor soul on the spot right away. Our lives have become unbearable. I risked my skin and ran away to find someone who can help us. Please {s0}, you are a {man/lady} of valor and a fearsome warrior, with many friends and soldiers at your service. If there is anyone who can help us, it's you.
column3: 一伙强盗躲进了我们的村子。他们抢走我们的一切，逼我们伺候他们，对我们作恶多端。只要我们当中有谁敢说半个不字，他们当场就把那个可怜人杀了。我们的日子已经过不下去了。我冒着生命危险逃出来，想找个能帮我们的人。求求您，{s0}，您是一位英勇的{人/女士}，一位令人生畏的战士，有许多朋友和士兵为您效力。如果说有谁能帮我们，那就是您了。

column2: Why don't you go to the {reg0?mistress:lord} of your village? {reg0?She:He} should take care of the vermin.
column3: 你为什么不去找你们村子的{reg0?女主人:领主}？{reg0?她:他}应该收拾那些害虫。

column2: Our {reg0?lady:lord} is imprisoned, so we cannot go to {reg0?her:him} for protection. Please {s0}, you {reg1?are:look like} a {man/lady} of valor, {reg1?with:and you have no doubt} many friends and soldiers at your service.  If there is anyone who can help us, it's you.
column3: 我们的{reg0?女领主:领主}被关押了，所以我们没法去求{reg0?她:他}保护。求求您，{s0}，您{reg1?是:看起来像是}一位英勇的{人/女士}，{reg1?有:想必也有}许多朋友和士兵为您效力。如果说有谁能帮我们，那就是您了。

column2: We have no lord, so we cannot go to him for protection. Please {s0}, you {reg1?are:look like} a {man/lady} of valor, {reg1?with:and you have no doubt} many friends and soldiers at your service.  If there is anyone who can help us, it's you.
column3: 我们没有领主，所以没法去求他保护。求求您，{s0}，您{reg1?是:看起来像是}一位英勇的{人/女士}，{reg1?有:想必也有}许多朋友和士兵为您效力。如果说有谁能帮我们，那就是您了。

column2: I did, {s0}, but our {reg0?lady:lord}'s {reg0?servants:men} did not let me see {reg0?her:him} and said {reg0?she:he} was occupied with more important matters and that we should deal with our own problem ourselves. Please {s0}, you {reg1?are:look like} a {man/lady} of valor and a fearsome warrior, {reg1?with:and you have no doubt} many friends and soldiers at your service.  If there is anyone who can help us, it's you.
column3: 我找过了，{s0}，可是我们{reg0?女领主:领主}的{reg0?仆人:手下}不让我见{reg0?她:他}，说{reg0?她:他}有更重要的事要处理，还说我们应该自己解决自己的问题。求求您，{s0}，您{reg1?是:看起来像是}一位英勇的{人/女士}，一位令人生畏的战士，{reg1?有:想必也有}许多朋友和士兵为您效力。如果说有谁能帮我们，那就是您了。

column2: God bless you, {s0}. Our village is {s7}. It is not too far from here.
column3: 上天保佑您，{s0}。我们的村子是{s7}。离这里不太远。

column2: We are but poor farmers {s0}, and the bandits have already got most of what we have on this world. but we'll be glad to share with you whatever we have got. And we'll always be in your gratitude if you help us.
column3: 我们只是穷苦的农民，{s0}，那些强盗已经抢走了我们在这世上的大部分东西。不过我们很乐意把剩下的东西分给您。如果您帮了我们，我们会永远感激您。

column2: Thank you for helping us {s0}. Crush those bandits!
column3: 谢谢您帮助我们，{s0}。消灭那些强盗吧！

column2: What are you looking at, {s0}? Unless you want to buy a round of drinks, get lost!
column3: 你看什么看，{s0}？除非你想请大家喝一轮酒，否则就滚开！

column2: Of course {sir/madam}. We'll be leaving shortly.
column3: 当然，{先生/夫人}。我们马上就走。

column2: That sounds good. But I can't afford to hire any more {reg65?soldiers:men} right now.
column3: 听上去不错。但我现在雇不起更多的{reg65?士兵:人}了。

column2: That sounds good. But I can't lead any more {reg65?soldiers:men} right now.
column3: 听上去不错。但我现在带不了更多的{reg65?士兵:人}了。

column2: It does my heart good to see such a promising talent. You have passed all tiers of training. You can now tell everyone that you have been trained by the master of the training field. If you have any recruits nearby that need a lesson, don't hesitate to see me.
column3: 看到这样有前途的人才真让我高兴。你已经通过了所有级别的训练。现在你可以告诉所有人，你是训练场的教头亲手训练出来的。如果你附近有需要上一课的新兵，尽管来找我。

column2: I wish you good luck in the future. And, just so that you're never out of practice, you can take this {s2} with you.  Also, if you want to practice your swordwork anytime, just come and say the word. Your companions are all welcome.
column3: 祝你今后好运。为了让你永远不生疏，你可以带上这把{s2}。另外，如果你什么时候想练练剑术，只管来说一声。你的同伴们也都欢迎。

column2: I wish you good luck in the tournaments. And, don't forget, if you want to practice your swordwork anytime, just come and say the word.
column3: 祝你在比武大会上好运。别忘了，如果你什么时候想练练剑术，只管来说一声。

column2: I will be requiring a set of merchant's clothing so as to conduct business.
column3: 我需要一套商人的衣服，好去做生意。

column2: As you wish, my {lord/lady}. I will have them delivered to you soon after the tailors have your measure.
column3: 遵命，我的{大人/夫人}。裁缝给您量好尺寸后，我很快就派人给您送去。

column2: You are indeed an extraordenary person, {sir/madame}, and it is an honour for me to have known you. You not only did what was impossible and put an end to this terrible war, but you won't even accept a reward for it. Very well, I will not insist on the matter, but please know that you will have our eternal respect and gratitude.
column3: 您真是一位非凡的人物，{先生/夫人}，能认识您是我的荣幸。您不仅做到了不可能的事，结束了这场可怕的战争，甚至还不接受任何奖赏。好吧，我不再坚持，但请您知道，您将永远得到我们的尊敬和感激。

column2: Well, you seem like a shrewd enough {lass/fellow}, despite that stupid hat, you're more than welcome to invest money here. Whether you'll be able to make a profit remains to be seen.
column3: 好吧，尽管你戴着那顶傻帽子，你看起来还是个够精明的{姑娘/家伙}，非常欢迎你在这里投资。至于你能不能赚到钱，那就得走着瞧了。

column2: Of course, {s0}. You are the lord of this town, and no one is going to stop you.
column3: 当然，{s0}。您是这座城镇的领主，没人会阻拦您。

column2: Very good, {s0}. We in the guild know and trust you, and I think I could find someone to sell you the land you need.
column3: 很好，{s0}。我们行会的人都认识并信任您，我想我能找到人把您需要的土地卖给您。

column2: I am but your humble servant, the guildmaster of {s9}. The folks of {s9} sometimes ask me to manage tasks that are beneath your notice.
column3: 我只是您卑微的仆人，{s9}的行会会长。{s9}的百姓有时会让我去处理一些不值得您费心的事务。

column2: I am the guildmaster of {s9}. You can say I am the leader of the good people of {s9}. {reg5?Though you may not have heard of me, I have heard of your {reg4?dastardly:good} deeds, {playername}:I can help you find a job if you are looking for some honest work}.
column3: 我是{s9}的行会会长。你可以说我是{s9}善良百姓的首领。{reg5?虽然你也许没听说过我，但我听说过你的{reg4?卑劣:善良}事迹，{playername}:如果你想找份正当的工作，我可以帮你找一份}。

column2: Our town's lord and protector is {s10}. {reg10?Until then:{reg5?{reg0?She:He} owns the castle and sometimes resides there, and collects taxes from the town:It is not everyday that we are blessed with your presence}. However} we regulate ourselves in most of the matters that concern ourselves. As the town's guildmaster I have the authority to decide those things.
column3: 我们镇的领主和守护者是{s10}。{reg10?在那之前:{reg5?{reg0?她:他}拥有这座城堡，有时会住在那里，并向镇上征税:我们并不是天天都有幸得见您}。不过}，在大部分关系到我们自身的事情上，我们都是自己管理的。作为镇上的行会会长，我有权决定这些事情。

column2: In practice, to make war is exhausting work. It is easy enough to lay waste to the enemy's farmland, but crops will grow back, and it is a far different matter to capture an enemy stronghold and to hold it. So the monarchs of Calradia will fight a little, sign a truce, fight a little more, and so on and so forth. Often, a monarch will go to war when another realm provokes them. At such times, some bad influences who look to enrich themselves with ransoms and pillage will clamor for retribution, and thus the damage caused by war to a monarch's treasury is less than the damage caused by doing nothing would be to his authority... Of course, your highness is far more experienced in these matters, as I and the humble folks here would not presume to know anything of strategy...
column3: 实际上，打仗是件劳民伤财的事。蹂躏敌人的农田很容易，但庄稼还会重新长出来，而攻下敌人的要塞并守住它就完全是另一回事了。所以卡拉迪亚的君主们会打一阵子，签个停战协议，再打一阵子，就这样循环往复。君主们常常在别国挑衅时开战。这时，一些想靠赎金和劫掠发财的坏家伙就会叫嚷着要报复，于是战争对君主国库造成的损失，还比不上无所作为对他威信造成的损害……当然，殿下在这些事情上远比我们有经验，我和这里的平头百姓可不敢妄谈什么战略……

column2: In practice, to make war is exhausting work. It is easy enough to lay waste to the enemy's farmland, but crops will grow back, and it is a far different matter to capture an enemy stronghold and to hold it. I'm of course not talking about {s10}, as no one would ever question {reg4?her:his} authority
