column2: {reg5?Hypothetically speaking, what would be my:What is {s10}'s} policy in regards to the other realms of Calradia?
column3: {reg5?假设来说，我对卡拉迪亚其他王国的政策会是:{s10}对卡拉迪亚其他王国的政策是}什么？

column2: What realms? {reg10?Your Majesty:Our liege} has conquered them all!
column3: 什么王国？{reg10?陛下:我们的君主}已经把它们全都征服了！

column2: Well, here in the {s4} we are all united by our love for {reg5?your grace:{s5}} and support for {reg5?your:{reg4?her:his} legitimate claim to the} rulership of all Calradia. But I have heard some talk of internal bickering in other realms...
column3: 这么说吧，在{s4}，我们因为对{reg5?殿下:{s5}}的敬爱而团结一心，拥护{reg5?您:{reg4?她:他}}对整个卡拉迪亚的合法统治权。不过我听说其他王国内部有些争吵……

column2: Now, men do not trust a vassal who turns coat easily. But I'm sure your grace know the heart and mind of the realm, keeping better council than myself.
column3: 如今，人们不会信任一个轻易倒戈的封臣。不过我相信殿下深知这个王国的人心所向，比我更懂得谋划。

column2: Do you have any insight into the realm's domestic policies?
column3: 你对王国的内政政策有什么见解吗？

column2: Well, there is a very great favor which you could do us... As you may have heard, some {s10}s have come across the border to attack our people. {s5} is under great pressure from some of the more bellicose of {reg0?her:his} vassals to respond with a declaration of war. Unfortunately, while the great lords of this land grow rich from bloodshed, we of the commons will be caught in the middle, and will suffer.
column3: 嗯，有件事您能帮我们一个大忙……您可能已经听说了，一些{s10}人越过边境袭击了我们的人民。{s5}正承受着{reg0?她:他}手下一些好战封臣的巨大压力，要求以宣战作为回应。不幸的是，这片土地上的大领主们靠流血发财，而我们这些平民却会被夹在中间，受苦受难。

column2: We are not saying that {s5} should overlook this aggression -- far from it! But if {reg0?she:he} charges one of {reg0?her:his} own lords to respond, then the cycle of provocation will necessarily lead to a full-fledged confrontation. Now, if an outsider were to step in and defeat a {s10} lord in battle, then honor would be done, and it would defuse the clamor for war. If the defeated lord were a known troublemaker -- {s7} -- then the {s10}s might be able to overlook it.
column3: 我们不是说{s5}应该对这次侵略视而不见——远非如此！但如果{reg0?她:他}派自己的某位领主去回击，挑衅的循环必然会导致全面冲突。现在，如果有个外人插手，在战斗中打败一位{s10}领主，荣誉就得到了维护，开战的呼声也就会平息。如果被打败的领主是个出了名的麻烦制造者——{s7}——那么{s10}人也许就能睁一只眼闭一只眼。

column2: I have a cargo of {s6} that needs to be delivered to the tavern in {s4}. If you can take {reg5} units of {s6} to {s4} in 7 days before any goes bad, you may earn {reg8} denars. What do you say?
column3: 我有一批{s6}需要送到{s4}的酒馆。如果你能在7天内、在货物变质之前把{reg5}份{s6}送到{s4}，你就能挣到{reg8}第纳尔。你说呢？

column2: I have a shipment of {s6} that needs to be delivered to the goods merchant in {s4}. If you can take {reg5} units of {s6} to {s4} in 7 days, you may earn {reg8} denars. What do you say?
column3: 我有一批{s6}需要送到{s4}的杂货商那里。如果你能在7天内把{reg5}份{s6}送到{s4}，你就能挣到{reg8}第纳尔。你说呢？

column2: There have been attempts to reconcile the two sides and reach a settlement. However, there are powerful lords on both sides whose interests lie in continuing the war. {reg0?They:These men} urge all others not to heed to the word of sensible men, but to keep fighting. While these leaders remain influential, no peace settlement can be reached.
column3: 双方曾尝试和解并达成协议。然而，双方都有一些强大的领主，继续战争符合他们的利益。{reg0?他们:这些人}怂恿其他人不要听信明智之人的话，而要继续打下去。只要这些首领仍有影响力，就无法达成和平协议。

column2: Please, {playername}, I beg of you leave us alone... What have we ever done to offend you?!
column3: 求求你，{playername}，我求你放过我们吧……我们到底哪里得罪你了？！

column2: Welcome to {s9}, {s0}. We were rejoiced by the news that you are the new {lord/lady} of our humble village. I am the village elder and I will be honoured to serve you in any way I can.
column3: 欢迎来到{s9}，{s0}。听说您成了我们这个简陋村庄的新{领主/女领主}，我们都很高兴。我是村长，我会尽我所能为您效劳，深感荣幸。

column2: Good day, {s0}, and welcome to {s9}. I am the elder of this village.
column3: 你好，{s0}，欢迎来到{s9}。我是这个村的村长。

column2: Your highness, you honour our humble village with your presence.
column3: 殿下，您的光临让我们这个简陋的村庄蓬荜生辉。

column2: I am looking for my chamberlain. I was told he preceded me here.
column3: 我在找我的内务大臣。有人告诉我他先到这里来了。

column2: Court members come and go to our village, {sir/madam}. If he is taking a break here, you will surely find him if you wait awhile.
column3: 宫廷里的人常来常往，{先生/夫人}。如果他在这里歇脚，您稍等一会儿肯定就能找到他。

column2: Oh hi there... Didn't expect you to go around inspecting your property that often, so I figured I'd take a stroll to the quaint village of {s9}, collect some taxes, etc. Is there anything specific you wanted done here? Otherwise, talk to the village elder yonder.
column3: 哦，您好……没想到您会这么经常巡视自己的产业，所以我想我就到{s9}这个古朴的小村子来转转，收收税什么的。您有什么特别想在这里办的事吗？如果没有，就去跟那边的村长谈吧。

column2: Strangers come and go to our village, {playername}. It would be best if you would not concern yourself with their affairs now, {s0}.
column3: 很多陌生人出入我们的村子，{playername}。您现在最好别过问他们的事，{s0}。

column2: Strangers come and go to our village, {s0}. But I doubt you'll run into him at this hour of the night. You would have better luck during the day.
column3: 很多陌生人出入我们的村子，{s0}。不过我怀疑您这么晚了还能遇到他。您白天来运气会好一些。

column2: Strangers come and go to our village, {s0}. If he is hiding here, you will surely find him if you look around.
column3: 很多陌生人出入我们的村子，{s0}。如果他藏在这里，您到处找找一定能找到他。

column2: Actually, I need a set of whatever it is your peasants are wearing.
column3: 其实，我需要一套你们农民穿的衣服。

column2: Of course, {s0}. You may do as you see fit with these clothes off my own back.
column3: 当然，{s0}。我身上这套衣服，您想怎么处置都行。

column2: That won't be a problem, I can arrange for some freshly laundered tunics to be delivered.
column3: 这没问题，我可以安排人给您送几件刚洗干净的短袍来。

column2: We were attacked by {s1} {reg7?{reg7} days ago:just recently}...
column3: {reg7?{reg7}天前:就在最近}，我们遭到了{s1}的袭击……

column2: I am sorry, {s0}. We have neither seen nor heard of any war parties in this area.
column3: 很抱歉，{s0}。我们在这一带既没见过也没听说过有什么军队。

column2: No, {s0}. We haven't seen any war parties in this area for some time.
column3: 没有，{s0}。我们已经有一段时间没在这一带见过军队了。

column2: We have already agreed upon this, {s0}. I will do my best. You can trust me.
column3: 我们已经说好了，{s0}。我会尽力的。您可以相信我。

column2: A fire, {s0}! Fires are dangerous! Why would you want such a thing?
column3: 放火，{s0}！放火很危险！您为什么要这么做？

column2: I believe that we have already discussed this issue, {s0}.
column3: 我想我们已经讨论过这个问题了，{s0}。

column2: We talked about this before {s0} and your previous offers were low compared to the risk you want me to take.
column3: 我们之前谈过这件事，{s0}，跟您要我冒的风险相比，您之前出的价太低了。

column2: As you wish, {s0}. You have been a good friend to this village, and, even though there is a risk, we should be glad to return the favor. When do you want this fire to start?
column3: 如您所愿，{s0}。您一直是这个村子的好朋友，即使有风险，我们也很乐意报答您。您想什么时候放火？

column2: I'm sorry, {s0}. You will forgive me for saying this, but we don't exactly have good reason to trust you. This is too dangerous.
column3: 对不起，{s0}。恕我直言，我们实在没有什么理由信任您。这太危险了。

column2: As you say, {s0}. But in doing this, we are taking a very great risk. What's in it for us?
column3: 如您所说，{s0}。不过这样做我们要冒很大的风险。我们能得到什么好处？

column2: Thank you, {s0}. We are praying for your success everyday.
column3: 谢谢您，{s0}。我们每天都在为您的成功祈祷。

column2: Ah, I am sorry to hear that {s0}. I'll try to think of something else.
column3: 啊，听到这个消息我很难过，{s0}。我会试着想想别的办法。

column2: Well {s0} you are already engaged with a task helping us. We cannot ask more from you.
column3: {s0}，您已经在为我们办一件差事了。我们不能再向您提更多要求了。

column2: No {s0}, We don't have any other tasks for you.
column3: 没有了，{s0}，我们没有别的差事要交给您了。

column2: Thank you, {s0}. We'll be praying for you night and day.
column3: 谢谢您，{s0}。我们会日夜为您祈祷的。

column2: Yes {s0}, of course. I am sorry if I have bothered you with our troubles.
column3: 是的，{s0}，当然。如果我们的麻烦打扰了您，我很抱歉。

column2: You will? Oh, splendid! We would be deeply indebted to you, {s0}. I'll instruct the village folk to assemble here and receive your training. If you can teach us how to defend ourselves, I promise you'll receive everything we can give you in return for your efforts.
column3: 您愿意？哦，太好了！我们会对您感激不尽的，{s0}。我会让村民们到这里集合，接受您的训练。如果您能教会我们怎样保卫自己，我保证您会得到我们能给的一切，作为对您辛劳的回报。

column2: Yes, of course {s0}.  Thank you for your counsel.
column3: 是的，当然，{s0}。谢谢您的忠告。

column2: Thank you, {s0}, but we do not really need anything right now.
column3: 谢谢您，{s0}，不过我们现在什么都不需要。

column2: Welcome {s0}. What can I do for you?
column3: 欢迎，{s0}。我能为您做些什么？

column2: Good. Let me look through the weapons rack first.
Well, please choose a weapon which you'd like to use in the melee.
column3: 好吧，请选一件你想在混战中使用的武器。

column2: Who goes there? We are {s20}, on our way to {s21}.
column3: 来者何人？我们是{s20}，正在前往{s21}。

column2: I am {playername}. I'm just passing by.
What a coincidence. I was also on my way to {s21}. Here, let me give you some troops.
column3: 真巧。我也正要去{s21}。来，我给你一些部队。

column2: Thank you {sir/madam}. We'll be on our way now.
column3: 谢谢您，{先生/夫人}。我们这就上路了。

column2: I am {playername}. And I'm here to stop you from reaching your destination!
column3: 我是{playername}。我是来阻止你们到达目的地的！

column2: What!? We are under the protection of {s3}! Be certain {reg3?she:he} will take vengeance!
column3: 什么！？我们受{s3}的保护！你等着{reg3?她:他}来报复吧！

column2: Fine, let {reg3?her:him}! I shall go after that {reg3?bitch:varlot} after I've dealt with you!
column3: 好啊，让{reg3?她:他}来吧！收拾完你们，我就去找那个{reg3?贱人:混蛋}！

column2: Alright, go! But you haven't seen the last of {playername}!
column3: 好吧，走吧！不过你们还会再见到{playername}的！

column2: Silver without blood, that's our favorite kind! Hmm, having a look at you, I reckon you could easily come up with {reg5} denars. Pay it, and we'll let you be on your way.
column3: 只 谋 财 不 害 命 ， 这 是 我 们 最 希 望 见 到 的 ！ 嗯 ， 看 你 面 相 ， 我 估 摸 着 你 能 很 容 易 整 出 {reg5}第 纳 尔 来 。 拿 出 来 ， 我 们 就 让 你 继 续 上 路 。

column2: I don't have that much money with me...
Ok. We'll leave you in peace for this time, do not face us again.
column3: 好吧。这次我们就放过你，别再让我们碰见你。

column2: Have you no mercy? {reg20?We will fight you to the last man:I will fight with my last breath}!
column3: 你就没有一点怜悯之心吗？{reg20?我们会和你战斗到最后一个人:我会战斗到最后一口气}！

column2: {s1} wants you alive and well, so don't be trying something we'll both regret.
column3: {s1}要你活得好好的，所以别做什么让我们俩都后悔的事。

column2: Wait {playername}, I have something to tell you.
column3: 等等，{playername}，我有件事要告诉你。

column2: Though it may seem to you that I have foresworn my service to {s5}, I swear that I was made the scapegoat for the crimes {s4} accused me of.
column3: 虽然在你看来我似乎背弃了对{s5}的效忠，但我发誓，{s4}指控我的那些罪行，是让我当了替罪羊。

column2: I think not. I'll take the word of {s4} over such a pathetic excuse any day.
column3: 我看不是。比起这种可怜的借口，我随时都宁愿相信{s4}的话。

column2: Now that I think about it, the story doesn't add up... You may go, before I change my mind.
column3: 现在想想，这个故事确实说不通……你走吧，趁我还没改变主意。

column2: Greetings, {s0}. How can I serve you today?
column3: 你好，{s0}。今天我能为您做些什么？

column2: I'd like to sell some weapons.
I'd like to sell some armor.
I'd like to sell some horses to you.
Let's see, aside from your personal equipment, I see {reg1} {reg3?things:thing} that I would buy for {reg0} {reg2?denars:denar}.  Do we have a deal?
column3: 让我看看，除了你的随身装备，我看到有{reg1}件{reg3?物品:物品}我愿意出{reg0}{reg2?第纳尔:第纳尔}买下。成交吗？

column2: Sure.  Pleasure doing business with you.
column3: 当然。很高兴和你做生意。

column2: Not exactly.  Let me show you what I meant.
column3: 不完全是。让我给你看看我的意思。

column2: Aside from what I presume is your personal equipment, I don't see anything that I would be interested in buying.
column3: 除了我想是你随身装备的东西，我没看到任何我有兴趣买的东西。

column2: Let me show you what I meant.
column3: 让我给你看看我的意思。

column2: Ah, yes {s0}. These arms are the best you'll find anywhere.
column3: 是啊，{s0}。这些武器是您在任何地方都找不到的上品。

column2: Of course, {s0}. You won't find better quality armour than these in all Calradia.
column3: 当然，{s0}。在整个卡拉迪亚，您都找不到比这些质量更好的盔甲了。

column2: You have a fine eye for horses, {s0}. You won't find better beasts than these anywhere else.
column3: 您很会相马，{s0}。您在别处找不到比这些更好的牲口了。

column2: Disaster has struck my family, {s0}. We have no land of our own, and the others have no money to pay for our labor, or even to help us. My poor children lie at home hungry and sick. I don't know what we'll do.
column3: 灾难降临到我家了，{s0}。我们自己没有地，别人也没钱雇我们干活，甚至帮不了我们。我可怜的孩子们躺在家里又病又饿。我不知道我们该怎么办。

column2: My life is miserable, {s0}. I haven't been able to find a job for months, and my poor children go to bed hungry each night. My neighbours are too poor themselves to help me.
column3: 我的日子太苦了，{s0}。我已经好几个月找不到活干了，我可怜的孩子们每天晚上都饿着肚子睡觉。我的邻居们自己也穷得帮不了我。

column2: Thank you for your kindness {s0}. With your help our lives will be better. I will pray for you everyday.
column3: 谢谢您的好心，{s0}。有了您的帮助，我们的日子会好起来的。我每天都会为您祈祷。

column2: Times are hard, {s0}. We work hard all day and yet we go to sleep hungry most nights.
column3: 日子很艰难，{s0}。我们整天辛苦干活，可大多数晚上还是饿着肚子睡觉。

column2: Times are hard, {s0}. But we must count our blessings.
column3: 日子很艰难，{s0}。不过我们还是得知足。

column2: We are not doing too badly {s0}. We must count our blessings.
column3: 我们过得还不算太坏，{s0}。我们得知足。

column2: All is quiet {s0}. Nothing to report.
column3: 一切平静，{s0}。没什么要报告的。

column2: Good day, {s0}. Always an honor to have you here in {s10}.
column3: 你好，{s0}。能在{s10}见到您永远是我们的荣幸。

column2: We are not supposed to talk while on guard, {s0}.
column3: 我们站岗的时候不准说话，{s0}。

column2: I want you to let the regular court members rejoin us.
column3: 我要你让常驻的宫廷成员重新回来见我。

column2: I will be speaking to any unlanded lords petitioning for an audience.

column2: I have no intention of losing my lands, {s65}.

Hrmph. Now do not be hasty with such words, {playername}. I deserve more respect than that, I think. Those lands belong to me and my heirs as you swore. If you continue down this route you will do me great offense, and there is no need for this to come to blows.
column3: 哼。别这么草率地说出这种话，{playername}。我想我应该得到更多的尊重。正如你所宣誓的，那些领地属于我和我的继承人。如果你继续这样下去，就会严重冒犯我，而我们没有必要为此兵戎相见。

column2: You've grown rash, {playername}. Your oath binds you to me and you govern what you do at my will. Think about what it is you are saying, as it is far from wise and will end poorly for you. You'd do well to reconsider.
column3: 你变得鲁莽了，{playername}。你的誓言把你和我绑在一起，你的所作所为要听从我的意志。想想你在说什么，这很不明智，对你不会有好下场。你最好重新考虑一下。

column2: You are right, {s65}. The lands are yours, but still I must go.
column3: 您说得对，{s65}。领地是您的，但我还是得走。

column2: My blood and sweat earned those lands, not yours. They are mine.
column3: 那些领地是我用血汗换来的，不是你的。它们是我的。

column2: You disappoint me greatly, {playername}. You may have once had my confidence, but this is beyond reason. Do not doubt that I will defend my house's honor from your insult. This is war between us.
column3: 你太让我失望了，{playername}。你也许曾经得到过我的信任，但这太过分了。毫无疑问，我会捍卫我家族的荣誉，不容你侮辱。我们之间开战了。

column2: I should have seen your treachery coming. I must be growing soft to have been fool enough to miss your schemes. No matter. Your time will yet come, {playername}. Justice is swiftest on a field of battle.
column3: 我早该料到你会背叛。我一定是变得心慈手软了，才会蠢到没看穿你的阴谋。不要紧。你的报应还会来的，{playername}。战场上的正义来得最快。

column2: I hold you in no ill-esteem, {s65}. I do only what is just.
column3: 我对您并无恶意，{s65}。我只是做我认为正当的事。

column2: We all do what we must. Good bye.
column3: 我们都在做我们必须做的事。再见。

column2: Then I await the day we meet in battle.
column3: 那我就等着我们在战场上相见的那一天。

column2: This is a dark day, {playername}. It will be marked and rued throughout the {s1}. Your treachery will not be soon forgotten. It would be best if you left quickly.

column2: Given the way things stand between us at the moment, {playername}, I would not consider it prudent to enter into such an arrangement.

column2: {playername}, I am grateful to you, but in the eyes of the people you do not have sufficient legitimacy as a potential co-ruler.  Marrying you would undermine my own claim to the throne.
column3: {playername}，我很感激你，但在人民眼中，你作为共同统治者的合法性还不够。和你结婚会削弱我自己对王位的继承权。

column2: {playername}, I know that if it were not for you I would not sit on this throne, but your name is little renowned in Calradia.  Marrying you would be perceived as an uneven match and would call into question my own claim to the throne.

column2: {playername}, I am grateful for your assistance in regaining my rightful throne, but you do not have sufficient personal holdings to be a suitable match for me.  It would be an uneven partnership.

column2: {playername}, I am grateful to you, but if I were to accept at this time I would risk offending powerful lords such as {s15}, who may consider themselves to have honor equal to or greater than your own.

column2: {playername}, while I am grateful to you, I must confess I am fond of {s15}.

低：^^- 分配封地时，据点分值按（村庄1 / 城堡2 / 城镇3）计算，而不是（村庄1 / 城堡1 / 城镇2）。^- 在营救俘虏和送礼任务中，可以作为任务目标的亲属扩大到了叔伯、姑姨和姻亲。^- 修改了王位觊觎者任务中据点分值的计算。^- 选择新阵营时，如果满足重新加入的一般条件，领主们更有可能回到原来的阵营（除非那正是他们被流放的阵营）。领主的决定还可能受到他与各阵营中其他领主关系的影响，而不仅仅是与阵营首领的关系。^^中：^^- 分配封地时领主关系的增减有一些变化。^- 在阵营事务上，国王否决领主的频率略有降低。^- 在决定支持谁获得封地时，某些性格的参数有细微变化。即使关系略为负面，一些领主仍会优先考虑没有封地的领主或攻下该据点的领主（通常所有性格的分界线都是0）。^- 当领主在一般规则下找不到合适的封地人选时，他会使用加权评分方案，而不是自动支持自己。^- 在许多使用平均声望 * 3/2 的地方，有时会改用另一种计算方式。^- 领主们会根据性格在城镇中进行额外的部队升级和雇佣兵招募。^^高：^^- 当NPC领主或玩家追求NPC女士时，声望因素会根据女士监护人的威望进行调整。^- 当一个阵营有没有封地的领主而又没有空闲封地时，在某些情况下国王会重新分配自己拥有的一座村庄。^- 村庄遭到洗劫时，村里的志愿兵都会被杀死，无论对玩家还是NPC都是如此。

低：^^- 阵营政策滑块会影响作为君主或封臣的税收损耗（集权）。^- 商队贸易对出发地和目的地都有好处。^- 玩家投降时，根据接受投降的一方和难度设置，有一定几率个人装备不会被抢走。（这是为了解决一个游戏性问题。在最初大约700天里，投降与战斗到最后一人相比没有任何好处。）此外，修正了一个可能导致书籍等物品被抢走的错误。^- AI商队在选择下一个目的地时会考虑距离，并且会稍微更倾向于去本阵营的据点。这种策略与原版策略混合使用，因此贸易模式会有所不同，但差别不会太大。^- 城镇商人的金钱按繁荣度缩放（最多变化40%）。^- 被围攻至少48小时的城镇食物价格会上涨。^- 调整了城镇中的贸易惩罚脚本，使把货物卖给专营该类货物的商人更划算。^- 根据物品管理技能，食物有一定几率不会腐坏。^- 村庄遭到劫掠现在会推迟建设项目。^- 贸易队伍会把俘虏送到有城墙的据点。^^中：^^- 你的配偶和拥有首都可以有效地让你多持有一个据点，因为税收损耗上限会被抵消一个。^- 城镇的食物消耗会随着繁荣度的提高而增加。消耗也会随着驻军规模的扩大而增加。^- 劫掠村庄不再正好获得30件物品。^- 领主的掠夺技能会影响他们打败玩家时从玩家身上拿走多少钱。^- 领主的统御技能会像对玩家一样影响他们的部队工资开销。^- 和领主一样，玩家的封地被洗劫时也会损失金钱。^- 与领主队伍规模随玩家进展而增加的方式相同，雇佣兵队伍的规模也会增加，以保持其作用。（增长率与领主相同：每级增加1.25%。）^- 如果玩家拥有自己的王国，其配偶会获得本应属于君主的部分奖励。奖励多少取决于玩家持有的封地数量。此奖励不与元帅奖励叠加。^- 如果NPC拥有的据点付不起工资，就会出现兵员损耗，但仅限于超过一定阈值时。^- 陌生人无法获得产业（门槛为1而不是0，所以你得先做点什么）。^- 村庄繁荣度会影响强盗的猖獗程度（有恶性循环的可能）。^- 现在你买牛时，钱会交给村长。^- 村庄农民队伍会把村长物品栏中多余的物品带到集镇出售。^^高：^^- 卡拉迪亚各国国王每周获得的奖励金总额保持不变：当有国王流亡时，他们的奖励会分给其余的国王。^- 如果有领主在支付队伍工资后个人金钱仍有盈余，多出的钱会根据领主本人或他的某座要塞是否缺钱，在领主和他的驻军预算之间分配（每座城堡和城镇都有自己用于支付士兵的资金池）。（如果都不缺钱，领主会像以前一样拿走全部。）^- 冒犯行为造成的荣誉损失部分取决于玩家当时的荣誉。名声越清白，一次丢脸的影响就越大。^- 劫掠的变化：村庄损失的金钱会先从未收取的税款中扣除，剩余部分（如果有的话）再从领主那里扣除。^- 每周从据点中清除的俘虏实际上会以1:10的比例被赎走，以增加当地的财富。^- 允许取消改进设施（钱会回到当地经济中，但关系会受损）。
